name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_le_roundUp
statement: theorem prawitz_le_roundUp (x : ℚ) : x ≤ prawitzRoundUp x

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_rational_pi_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_rational_pi_bounds :
    (314159 / 100000 : ℝ) ≤ Real.pi ∧ Real.pi ≤ 314160 / 100000

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_taylor16_pos_le_exp
statement:
theorem prawitz_taylor16_pos_le_exp (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 < (∑ m ∈ range 16, x ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ∧
      (∑ m ∈ range 16, x ^ m / (m.factorial : ℝ)) ≤ Real.exp x

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_compact_parameter_cell_exists
statement:
theorem prawitz_compact_parameter_cell_exists
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ0 : 1 / 100 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ j : Fin 270, (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ) ≤ ρ ∧
      ρ ≤ (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_compact_real_cutoff_enclosures
statement:
theorem prawitz_compact_real_cutoff_enclosures
    (j : Fin 270) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hrρ : (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ) ≤ ρ)
    (hρs : ρ ≤ (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)) :
    let B := (prawitzLowCutoffIndex j.val : ℝ) / 200
    let A := (prawitzHighCutoffIndex j.val : ℝ) / 1000
    let U0 := max (3 / 2 : ℝ) (Real.sqrt (4 * Real.log (1 / ρ)))
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    U0 ≤ B ∧ B ≤ U ∧ U * A ≤ U0

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_kernel_rational_square_certificate
statement:
theorem prawitz_kernel_rational_square_certificate
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    prawitzRationalKernelSq i ≤
      ((prawitzKernelMagnitudeIndex i : ℚ) / 1000000) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_rescaled_lower_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_rescaled_lower_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    let Q := (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 +
      (((1 - a) * (1 - (Real.pi * a) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * b) ^ 4 / 24) /
        (Real.pi * a * (1 - (Real.pi * b) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    (∫ t in (U * a)..(U * b),
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (12 / (5 * r)) * (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_rescaled_upper_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_rescaled_upper_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 1 / 2 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    let U := 12 / (5 * ρ)
    let Q := (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - a) ^ 4 / 16
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    (∫ t in (U * a)..(U * b),
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (12 / (5 * r)) * (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_rescaled_moment_cell_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_rescaled_moment_cell_bound
    (ρ s u a b : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hau : a ≤ u) (hub : u ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ ((12 / (5 * ρ)) * u) ≤
      min 1 (Real.exp (max
        ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
        ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_real_exponential_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_real_exponential_enclosure
    (j : Fin 270) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    let s := (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 1000
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1000
    let E := max ((-72 * a ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * a ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
      ((-72 * b ^ 2 / 25 + 1728 * b ^ 3 / 625) / s ^ 2)
    let aq := (i : ℚ) / 1000
    let bq := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) / 1000
    let e := min (72 * aq ^ 2 / 25 - 1728 * aq ^ 3 / 625)
      (72 * bq ^ 2 / 25 - 1728 * bq ^ 3 / 625) /
        (prawitzCompactRight j.val) ^ 2
    Real.exp E ≤ ((1 / prawitzTaylor16 e : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_real_kernel_square_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_real_kernel_square_enclosure
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 1000) :
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 1000
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 1000
    let Q := if i < 500 then
      (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 +
        (((1 - a) * (1 - (Real.pi * a) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * b) ^ 4 / 24) /
          (Real.pi * a * (1 - (Real.pi * b) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
      else (1 - a) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - a) ^ 4 / 16
    Q ≤ (prawitzRationalKernelSq i : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_budget_high_compact
Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.gaussian_reciprocal_linear_tail_bound
statement:
theorem gaussian_reciprocal_linear_tail_bound
    (a b c : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioi a,
      (1 / (Real.pi * t) + c) * Real.exp (-(b * t ^ 2))) ≤
      (1 / (2 * Real.pi * b * a ^ 2) + c / (2 * b * a)) *
        Real.exp (-(b * a ^ 2))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_far_gaussian_tail_budget
statement:
theorem prawitz_far_gaussian_tail_budget

Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_compact_lower_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_compact_lower_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ))
    (hhalf : 5 * s * b / 12 ≤ 1 / 2) :
    let α := 5 * r * a / 12
    let β := 5 * s * b / 12
    let Q := (1 - α) ^ 2 / 4 +
      (((1 - α) * (1 - (Real.pi * α) ^ 2 / 2 + (Real.pi * β) ^ 4 / 24) /
        (Real.pi * α * (1 - (Real.pi * β) ^ 2 / 6)) + 1 / Real.pi) / 2) ^ 2
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_high_compact_upper_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_high_compact_upper_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ))
    (hhalf : 1 / 2 ≤ 5 * r * a / 12) :
    let α := 5 * r * a / 12
    let Q := (1 - α) ^ 2 / 4 + Real.pi ^ 2 * (1 - α) ^ 4 / 16
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzMomentEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * Real.sqrt Q * min 1 (Real.exp E)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_low_compact_endpoint_cell_integral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_low_compact_endpoint_cell_integral_bound
    (ρ r s a b : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hρs : ρ ≤ s)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbU : b ≤ 12 / (5 * ρ)) :
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (5 / 6 : ℝ) * (∫ t in a..b,
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / (12 / (5 * ρ)))‖ * prawitzDiscrepancyEnvelope ρ t) ≤
      (b - a) * (1 / (Real.pi * a) + 5 * s / 12) *
        min ((b ^ 3 / 6 + s * b ^ 4 / 8) * Real.exp (E / 2))
          ((min 1 (Real.exp E) + Real.exp (-(a ^ 2 / 2))) / r)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_low_real_cell_enclosure
statement:
theorem prawitz_low_real_cell_enclosure
    (j : Fin 270) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ Ico 1 (prawitzLowCutoffIndex j.val)) :
    let r := (prawitzCompactLeft j.val : ℝ)
    let s := (prawitzCompactRight j.val : ℝ)
    let a := (i : ℝ) / 200
    let b := ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 200
    let E := max (-(a ^ 2 / 2) + s * a ^ 3 / 5)
      (-(b ^ 2 / 2) + s * b ^ 3 / 5)
    (b - a) * (1 / (Real.pi * a) + 5 * s / 12) *
      min ((b ^ 3 / 6 + s * b ^ 4 / 8) * Real.exp (E / 2))
        ((min 1 (Real.exp E) + Real.exp (-(a ^ 2 / 2))) / r) ≤
          (prawitzRationalLowCell j.val i : ℝ)

statement:
theorem iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_local_product_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ) (hM3 : 1 ≤ M3)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : |t| ≤ Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)) :
    ‖(charFun μ (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) ^ n -
      charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖ ≤
      (M3 / (4 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) * |t| ^ 3 *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 4))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_interval_integral_bound
statement:
theorem iid_unit_variance_charFun_refined_interval_integral_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ) (hM3 : 1 ≤ M3)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    (∫ t in (-(Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)))..
        (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / (2 * M3)),
      ‖(charFun μ (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))) ^ n -
        charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖ / |t|) ≤
      2 * M3 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

statement:
theorem csc_squared_reciprocal_series (x : ℝ)
    (hsin : Real.sin (Real.pi * x) ≠ 0) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ =>
      1 / (x - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 + 1 / (x + ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2) ∧
    (Real.sin (Real.pi * x) / Real.pi) ^ 2 *
      (1 / x ^ 2 + (∑' n : ℕ,
        (1 / (x - ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2 +
         1 / (x + ((n : ℝ) + 1)) ^ 2))) = 1

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_tendsto
statement:
theorem prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_tendsto (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
      (1 - t) *
        (2 * r * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t) /
          (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t) + r ^ 2)) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t))
      (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1))
      (𝓝 (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        (1 - t) * Real.cos (Real.pi * t) / Real.sin (Real.pi * t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)))

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_series
statement:
theorem prawitz_abel_weighted_integral_series
    (x r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r < 1) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => r ^ (n + 1) *
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * t) *
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t))) ∧
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
      (2 * r * Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t) /
        (1 - 2 * r * Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t) + r ^ 2)) *
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)) =
      2 * (∑' n : ℕ, r ^ (n + 1) *
        (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1 - t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * t) *
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * x * t)))

statement:
theorem prawitz_cdf_error_of_spectral_bound (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x q R : ℝ)
    (hspectral :
      |1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) - 2 * q| +
        (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ) ≤ 2 * R) :

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_cdf_spatial_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_cdf_spatial_bounds (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x : ℝ) :
    (1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) -
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ)) / 2 ≤ (μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal ∧
    (μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal ≤
      (1 + (∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) +
        (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ)) / 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_halfLine_indicator_bounds
statement:
theorem prawitz_halfLine_indicator_bounds (U : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (x y : ℝ) :

      (Set.Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ∧
    (Set.Iic x).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) y ≤
      (1 + prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) + Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2) / 2

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_four_terms_integrable
statement:
theorem prawitz_four_terms_integrable
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
        ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) volume 0 U0 ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) volume U0 U ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
        Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) volume 0 U0 ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)
      (Set.Ioi U0)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.prawitz_gaussian_sine_spectral_bound
statement:
theorem prawitz_gaussian_sine_spectral_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) (x : ℝ) :
    |(∫ y, prawitzSignApprox (U * (x - y)) ∂μ) / 2 -
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) * Real.sin (t * x) / t)| +
      (∫ y, Real.sinc (U * (x - y) / 2) ^ 2 ∂μ) / 2 ≤
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
          ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) +
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in U0..U,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) +
      2 * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
          Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) +
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi U0,
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)

name: Causalean.Stat.CLT.BerryEsseen.normal_cdf_prawitz_smoothing
statement:
theorem normal_cdf_prawitz_smoothing
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hfirst : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => y) μ)
    (U0 U : ℝ) (hU0 : 0 < U0) (hcut : U0 ≤ U) (x : ℝ) :
    |(μ (Set.Iic x)).toReal -
      ((gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic x)).toReal| ≤
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ *
          ‖charFun μ t - charFun (gaussianReal 0 1) t‖) +
      (2 / U) * (∫ t in U0..U,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U)‖ * ‖charFun μ t‖) +
      2 * (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..U0,
        ‖prawitzKernel (t / U) / (U : ℂ) -
          Complex.I / ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ *
          Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2))) +
      (1 / Real.pi) * (∫ t in Set.Ioi U0,
        Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2)) / t)

    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (M3 : ℝ)
    (hmean_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x) μ)
    (hmean : ∫ x : ℝ, x ∂μ = 0)
    (hvar_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (hthird_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ 3) μ)
    (hthird : ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ^ 3 ∂μ ≤ M3)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x : ℝ) :
    |((Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ))
        {v : Fin n → ℝ |
          (∑ i : Fin n, v i) / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ≤ x}).toReal -
      ((gaussianReal 0 1) (Set.Iic x)).toReal| ≤
      M3 / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

    (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (N : ι → Finset ι)
    (hmeas : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hbound : ∀ i ω, |X i ω| ≤ B)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hindep : ∀ i, IndepFun (X i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ N i, X j ω) μ)
    (hvar : ∫ ω, (depSum X ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 1)
    (h : ℝ → ℝ) {C L : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ x, |h x| ≤ C) (hd : ∀ x, |deriv h x| ≤ L) (hdiff : Differentiable ℝ h) :
    |(∫ ω, h (depSum X ω) ∂μ) - gExpect h|
      ≤ 2 * L * Real.sqrt (variance (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω * nbhdSum X N i ω) μ)
        + L * ∑ i, ∫ ω, |X i ω| * (nbhdSum X N i ω) ^ 2 ∂μ

    (hvar : ∀ n, ∫ ω, (depSum (X n) ω) ^ 2 ∂(μ n) = 1)
    (herr1 : Tendsto
      (fun n => variance (fun ω => ∑ i, X n i ω * nbhdSum (X n) (N n) i ω) (μ n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (herr2 : Tendsto
      (fun n => ∑ i, ∫ ω, |X n i ω| * (nbhdSum (X n) (N n) i ω) ^ 2 ∂(μ n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (s : ℝ) :

    (hindep : ∀ n i, IndepFun (X n i) (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ N n i, X n j ω) (μ n))

name: Causalean.Experimentation.SuperPopulation.Network.MeanAsymptotics.networkMean_clt
statement:
theorem networkMean_clt
    {V : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, Fintype (V n)]
    {Ω : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, MeasurableSpace (Ω n)] (μ : ∀ n, Measure (Ω n))
    [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (Y : ∀ n, V n → Ω n → ℝ)
    (adj : ∀ n, V n → V n → Prop) [∀ n, DecidableRel (adj n)]
    (hrefl : ∀ n i, adj n i i) (hsymm : ∀ n i j, adj n i j → adj n j i)
    (hmeasY : ∀ n i, Measurable (Y n i))
    (hindepY : ∀ n, ∀ A B : Finset (V n), (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, ¬ adj n a b) →
      IndepFun (fun ω => fun k : A => Y n k ω) (fun ω => fun k : B => Y n k ω) (μ n))
    (m : ℕ) (hdeg : ∀ n i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => adj n i j)).card ≤ m)
    (hL2 : ∀ n i, MemLp (Y n i) 2 (μ n))
    (s : ℕ → ℝ) (hs_pos : ∀ n, 0 < s n)
    (hs2 : ∀ n, (s n) ^ 2 = variance (fun ω => ∑ i, Y n i ω) (μ n))
    (c : ℕ → ℝ) (hc : ∀ n i ω, |Y n i ω - ∫ x, Y n i x ∂(μ n)| ≤ c n)
    (hsmall : Tendsto (fun n => (Fintype.card (V n) : ℝ) * (c n / s n) ^ 3) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (μ n).real
        {ω | (∑ i, Y n i ω - ∑ i, ∫ x, Y n i x ∂(μ n)) / s n ≤ t})
      atTop (𝓝 ((gaussianReal 0 1).real (Set.Iic t)))

        G.edge (xp.get ⟨i, by omega⟩) (xp.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩))
    (hxp_Z : ∀ z ∈ xp, z ∉ Z)
    (hyp_len : yp.length ≥ 2) (hyp_head : yp.head? = some u)
    (hyp_last : yp.getLast? = some y)
    (hyp_edge : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < yp.length),
        G.edge (yp.get ⟨i, by omega⟩) (yp.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩))

    let p := xp.reverse ++ yp.tail

      G.IsActiveWalk Z p

    (hpa_last : pa.getLast? = some n) (hpa_act : G.IsActiveWalk Z pa)

    (hpb_last : pb.getLast? = some y) (hpb_act : G.IsActiveWalk Z pb)
    (hpa_in : G.edge (pa.get ⟨pa.length - 2, by omega⟩) n)
    (hpb_in : G.edge (pb.get ⟨1, by omega⟩) n)

      G.IsActiveWalk Z p

    (hno_n : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 2 < p.length),

theorem chain_join_active
    {Z : Finset V} {m x y : V} {pa pb : List V}
    (hpa_len : pa.length ≥ 2) (hpa_head : pa.head? = some x)
    (hpa_last : pa.getLast? = some m) (hpa_act : G.IsActiveWalk Z pa)
    (hpb_len : pb.length ≥ 2) (hpb_head : pb.head? = some m)
    (hpb_last : pb.getLast? = some y) (hpb_act : G.IsActiveWalk Z pb)

    (hedge : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < q.length),
      G.edge (q.get ⟨i, by omega⟩) (q.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩))

name: Causalean.Graph.DAG.survive_or_splice
statement:
theorem survive_or_splice {S A W bigQ : Finset V} {p : List V} {a n : V}
    (hbigQ : A ∪ {n} ∪ (S ∪ W) ⊆ bigQ)
    (hmax : ∀ m ∈ G.ancestralSet bigQ, G.topoOrder m ≤ G.topoOrder n)
    (haA : a ∈ A) (hlen : p.length ≥ 2) (hact : G.IsActiveWalk (S ∪ W) p)
    (hhead : p.head? = some a) (hlast : p.getLast? = some n) :
    (∃ (q : List V) (w : V), w ∈ W ∧ q.length ≥ 2 ∧ G.IsActiveWalk (insert n S) q ∧
        q.head? = some a ∧ q.getLast? = some w) ∨
    (∃ (q : List V) (hq2 : q.length ≥ 2), G.IsActiveWalk (insert n S) q ∧
        q.head? = some a ∧ q.getLast? = some n ∧
        G.edge (q.get ⟨q.length - 2, by omega⟩) n)

    (hq_len : q.length ≥ 2) (hq_head : q.head? = some c) (hq_last : q.getLast? = some b)
    (hq_edge : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 < q.length),
        G.edge (q.get ⟨i, by omega⟩) (q.get ⟨i + 1, hi⟩))
    (hq_int : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 2 < q.length), q.get ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ ∉ Z)
    (hcZ : c ∉ Z) :

      v ∈ Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitCube V →

    (j : V) (q : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞)

    (hqnorm : ∫⁻ x in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, q x ∂volume = 1) :

    (hnonneg : ∀ i : V, ∀ v, v ∈ Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitCube V → 0 ≤ p i v)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : V, ∀ {v w : V → ℝ},
      v ∈ Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitCube V →
      w ∈ Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitCube V →
      (∀ k ∈ insert i (G.parents i), v k = w k) → p i v = p i w)
    (hnorm : ∀ i : V, ∀ v : V → ℝ,
      v ∈ Causalean.Graph.FiniteDensity.unitCube V →
      ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, p i (Function.update v i x) ∂volume = 1)
    (j : V) (q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hqmeas : MeasurableOnSet q (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hqnonneg : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ q x)
    (hqnorm : ∫ x in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, q x ∂volume = 1) :
    (unitCubeFactorizationOfRealCubeFactors p hmeas hnonneg hlocal hnorm).interventionMeasure j

      realCubeInterventionDensityMeasure p j q

theorem isActiveWalk_skipOne {Z : Finset V} {p : List V} {k : ℕ}
    (hact : G.IsActiveWalk Z p) (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k + 1 < p.length)
    (hadj_splice : G.UAdj (p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) (p.get ⟨k + 1, hk⟩))
    (hleft : ∀ (hk2 : 2 ≤ k),
      if G.IsCollider (p.get ⟨k - 2, by omega⟩) (p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩)
          (p.get ⟨k + 1, hk⟩) then
        p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ ∈ G.bbZAncestors Z
      else
        p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ ∉ Z)
    (hright : ∀ (hkR : k + 2 < p.length),
      if G.IsCollider (p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) (p.get ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩)
          (p.get ⟨k + 2, hkR⟩) then
        p.get ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ ∈ G.bbZAncestors Z
      else
        p.get ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ ∉ Z) :
    G.IsActiveWalk Z (skipOne p k)

    (hsame : p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ = p.get ⟨k + 1, hk⟩)
    (hsplice : ∀ (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkR : k + 2 < p.length),
      if G.IsCollider (p.get ⟨k - 2, by omega⟩) (p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩)
          (p.get ⟨k + 2, hkR⟩) then
        p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ ∈ G.bbZAncestors Z
      else
        p.get ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩ ∉ Z) :
    G.IsActiveWalk Z (skipTwo p k)

    (f : ℕ → (I → ℕ) → ℝ) (s : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : Σ r : Fin (s + 1), ↥((Finset.univ : Finset I).piAntidiag r.val),
      f (s - x.1.val) x.2.val) =
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (s + 1),

    (hCZ : C ⊆ Z) (hZX : Z ⊆ X) (hne : Z ≠ X)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ Y, IsIrreducibleAffineClosed Y ∧ C ⊂ Y ∧ Y ⊂ X) :
    IsIrreducibleAffineComponent C Z

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.map_quotient_strictMono
statement:
lemma map_quotient_strictMono {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (I A B : Ideal R) (hIA : I ≤ A) (hAB : A < B) :
    A.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) < B.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.no_intermediate_of_exact_affine_dimensions
statement:
theorem no_intermediate_of_exact_affine_dimensions
    {ι : Type*} {d : ℕ} {C X : Set (ι → ℂ)}
    (hX : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed X)
    (hCdim : HasAffineZariskiDimension d C)
    (hXdim : HasAffineZariskiDimension (d + 1) X) :
    ¬ ∃ Y, IsIrreducibleAffineClosed Y ∧ C ⊂ Y ∧ Y ⊂ X

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.no_three_chain_of_minimalPrime_span
statement:
theorem no_three_chain_of_minimalPrime_span
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {C X : Set (ι → ℂ)}
    (hC : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed C)
    (hX : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed X)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι ℂ)
    (hmin : MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ C ∈
      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ X ⊔ Ideal.span {P}).minimalPrimes) :
    ¬ ∃ chain : Fin 3 → Set (ι → ℂ),
      StrictMono chain ∧ (∀ i, IsIrreducibleAffineClosed (chain i)) ∧
      chain 0 = C ∧ chain (Fin.last 2) = X

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_span_of_no_intermediate
statement:
theorem vanishingIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_span_of_no_intermediate
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {C X : Set (ι → ℂ)}
    (hC : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed C)
    (hX : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed X)
    (hCX : C ⊆ X)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι ℂ)
    (hPC : P ∈ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ C)
    (hPX : P ∉ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ X)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ Y, IsIrreducibleAffineClosed Y ∧ C ⊂ Y ∧ Y ⊂ X) :
    MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ C ∈
      (MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ X ⊔ Ideal.span {P}).minimalPrimes

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.eval_polynomialPullback
statement:
lemma eval_polynomialPullback {ι κ : Type*} (f : κ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ)
    (x : ι → ℂ) (P : MvPolynomial κ ℂ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (polynomialPullback f P) =
      MvPolynomial.eval (polynomialCoordinateMap f x) P

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.affineZariskiDimension_iff_coordinateRingKrullDim
statement:
theorem affineZariskiDimension_iff_coordinateRingKrullDim
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {d : ℕ} {Z : Set (ι → ℂ)}
    (hclosed : affineZariskiClosure Z = Z) :
    HasAffineZariskiDimension d Z ↔
      ringKrullDim
        (MvPolynomial ι ℂ ⧸ MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ Z) = d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.polynomialImageClosure_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem polynomialImageClosure_vanishingIdeal {ι κ : Type*}
    (f : κ → MvPolynomial ι ℂ) :
    MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal ℂ (polynomialImageClosure f) =
      RingHom.ker (polynomialPullback f)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.affineZariskiClosure_polynomial_image_of_dense
statement:
lemma affineZariskiClosure_polynomial_image_of_dense
    {ι κ : Type*} {f : (ι → ℂ) → (κ → ℂ)} (hf : IsPolynomialMap f)
    {A : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hA : affineZariskiClosure A = Set.univ) :
    affineZariskiClosure (f '' A) = affineZariskiClosure (Set.range f)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.irreducible_affineClosure_polynomial_image_of_dense
statement:
theorem irreducible_affineClosure_polynomial_image_of_dense
    {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {f : (ι → ℂ) → (κ → ℂ)} (hf : IsPolynomialMap f)
    {A : Set (ι → ℂ)} (hA : affineZariskiClosure A = Set.univ)
    (hne : A.Nonempty) :
    IsIrreducibleAffineClosed (affineZariskiClosure (f '' A))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.polynomialImageClosure_isIrreducible
statement:
theorem polynomialImageClosure_isIrreducible
    {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {f : (ι → ℂ) → (κ → ℂ)} (hf : IsPolynomialMap f) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.finiteCoordinateRange_closed
statement:
lemma finiteCoordinateRange_closed {κ : Type*} (c : κ) (S : Finset ℂ) :
    affineZariskiClosure {x : κ → ℂ | x c ∈ S} = {x | x c ∈ S}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.PolynomialImageDimension.irreducible_coordinate_constant_of_finite_range
statement:
theorem irreducible_coordinate_constant_of_finite_range {κ : Type*}
    {Z : Set (κ → ℂ)} (hZ : IsIrreducibleAffineClosed Z)
    (c : κ) (S : Finset ℂ) (hrange : ∀ x ∈ Z, x c ∈ S) :
    ∃ z ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ Z, x c = z

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus_finset_prod
statement:
theorem mvPolynomialZeroLocus_finset_prod
    (s : Finset κ) (p : κ → MvPolynomial σ ℝ) :
    mvPolynomialZeroLocus (∏ i ∈ s, p i) =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus_fintype_prod
statement:
theorem mvPolynomialZeroLocus_fintype_prod [Fintype κ]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus_subtype_prod
statement:
theorem mvPolynomialZeroLocus_subtype_prod
    (s : Finset κ) (p : {i // i ∈ s} → MvPolynomial σ ℝ) :

theorem mvPolynomial_finset_prod_ne_zero

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomial_fintype_prod_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_fintype_prod_ne_zero [Fintype κ]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomial_subtype_prod_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_subtype_prod_ne_zero
    (s : Finset κ) (p : {i // i ∈ s} → MvPolynomial σ ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalMap.eval_eq_iff_equalityPolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_eq_iff_equalityPolynomial_eq_zero (f g : RationalMap S T)
    (x : S → ℝ) (t : T)
    (hf : MvPolynomial.eval x (f.den t) ≠ 0)
    (hg : MvPolynomial.eval x (g.den t) ≠ 0) :
    f.eval x t = g.eval x t ↔
      MvPolynomial.eval x (equalityPolynomial f g t) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalMap.eval_ofPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_ofPolynomial (p : T → MvPolynomial S ℝ) (x : S → ℝ) :
    (ofPolynomial p).eval x = fun t => MvPolynomial.eval x (p t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalMap.eval_renameSource
statement:
theorem eval_renameSource (f : RationalMap S T) (e : S → U) (x : U → ℝ) :
    (f.renameSource e).eval x = f.eval (x ∘ e)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.conjunctionPolynomial_ne_zero_of_witness
statement:
theorem conjunctionPolynomial_ne_zero_of_witness [Fintype T]
    (p : T → MvPolynomial S ℝ) (x : S → ℝ) (t : T)
    (h : MvPolynomial.eval x (p t) ≠ 0) :
    conjunctionPolynomial p ≠ 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.eval_conjunctionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eval_conjunctionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff [Fintype T]
    (p : T → MvPolynomial S ℝ) (x : S → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (conjunctionPolynomial p) = 0 ↔
      ∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval x (p t) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.eval_unionConjunctionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eval_unionConjunctionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff [Fintype B] [Fintype T]
    (p : B → T → MvPolynomial S ℝ) (x : S → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x (unionConjunctionPolynomial p) = 0 ↔
      ∃ b, ∀ t, MvPolynomial.eval x (p b t) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap_definedOn
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap_definedOn [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
    (A : Matrix T T (MvPolynomial S ℝ)) (D : Set (S → ℝ))
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ D, MvPolynomial.eval x A.det ≠ 0) :
    (polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap A).DefinedOn D

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap_eval
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap_eval [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
    (A : Matrix T T (MvPolynomial S ℝ)) (x : S → ℝ)
    (hdet : MvPolynomial.eval x A.det ≠ 0) :
    (polynomialMatrixInverseRationalMap A).evalMatrix x =
      (evalPolynomialMatrix A x)⁻¹

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.polynomialMatrixRationalMap_eval
statement:
theorem polynomialMatrixRationalMap_eval
    (A : Matrix T U (MvPolynomial S ℝ)) (x : S → ℝ) :
    (polynomialMatrixRationalMap A).evalMatrix x = evalPolynomialMatrix A x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.rationalMap_eq_locus
statement:
theorem rationalMap_eq_locus [Fintype T]
    (f g : RationalMap S T) (D : Set (S → ℝ))
    (hf : f.DefinedOn D) (hg : g.DefinedOn D) :
    {x | x ∈ D ∧ f.eval x = g.eval x} =
      D ∩ Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus
        (conjunctionPolynomial (RationalMap.equalityPolynomial f g))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.rationalMap_eq_union_locus
statement:
theorem rationalMap_eq_union_locus [Fintype B] [Fintype T]
    (f g : B → RationalMap S T) (D : Set (S → ℝ))
    (hf : ∀ b, (f b).DefinedOn D) (hg : ∀ b, (g b).DefinedOn D) :
    {x | x ∈ D ∧ ∃ b, (f b).eval x = (g b).eval x} =
      D ∩ Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus
        (unionConjunctionPolynomial
          (fun b => RationalMap.equalityPolynomial (f b) (g b)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.rationalMap_imageIntersection_locus
statement:
theorem rationalMap_imageIntersection_locus [Fintype T]
    (f : RationalMap S T) (g : RationalMap U T)
    (D : Set (S → ℝ)) (E : Set (U → ℝ))
    (hf : f.DefinedOn D) (hg : g.DefinedOn E) :
    {z | z ∈ sumProductDomain D E ∧
      f.eval (z ∘ Sum.inl) = g.eval (z ∘ Sum.inr)} =
      sumProductDomain D E ∩
        Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus
          (conjunctionPolynomial
            (RationalMap.equalityPolynomial f.leftLift g.rightLift))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.rationalMatrixMap_imageIntersection_locus
statement:
theorem rationalMatrixMap_imageIntersection_locus [Fintype R] [Fintype C]
    (f : RationalMatrixMap S R C) (g : RationalMatrixMap U R C)
    (D : Set (S → ℝ)) (E : Set (U → ℝ))
    (hf : f.DefinedOn D) (hg : g.DefinedOn E) :
    {z | z ∈ sumProductDomain D E ∧
      f.evalMatrix (z ∘ Sum.inl) = g.evalMatrix (z ∘ Sum.inr)} =
      sumProductDomain D E ∩
        Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus
          (conjunctionPolynomial
            (RationalMap.equalityPolynomial f.leftLift g.rightLift))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.unionConjunctionPolynomial_ne_zero_of_witnesses
statement:
theorem unionConjunctionPolynomial_ne_zero_of_witnesses [Fintype B] [Fintype T]
    (p : B → T → MvPolynomial S ℝ)
    (witness : B → S → ℝ) (coordinate : B → T)
    (h : ∀ b, MvPolynomial.eval (witness b) (p b (coordinate b)) ≠ 0) :
    unionConjunctionPolynomial p ≠ 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalScalar.derivativePolynomial_ne_zero_of_formallyNonconstant
statement:
theorem derivativePolynomial_ne_zero_of_formallyNonconstant [Fintype S]

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalScalar.derivativePolynomial_ne_zero_of_nonconstantOn_convex
statement:
theorem derivativePolynomial_ne_zero_of_nonconstantOn_convex
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (r : RationalScalar S) (D : Set (S → ℝ)) (hconvex : Convex ℝ D)
    (hD : r.DefinedOn D)
    (x y : S → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ D) (hy : y ∈ D) (hne : r.eval x ≠ r.eval y) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalScalar.derivativePolynomial_ne_zero_of_witness
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalScalar.derivative_zero_locus
statement:
theorem derivative_zero_locus [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (r : RationalScalar S) (D : Set (S → ℝ)) (hD : r.DefinedOn D) :
    {x | x ∈ D ∧ fderiv ℝ r.eval x = 0} =
      D ∩ Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.mvPolynomialZeroLocus
        r.derivativePolynomial

name: Causalean.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.RationalScalar.fderiv_eq_zero_iff_derivativePolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_eq_zero_iff_derivativePolynomial_eq_zero [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (r : RationalScalar S) (x : S → ℝ)
    (hden : MvPolynomial.eval x r.den ≠ 0) :
    fderiv ℝ r.eval x = 0 ↔
      MvPolynomial.eval x r.derivativePolynomial = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Schedule.left_le_of_get_lt
statement:
theorem Schedule.left_le_of_get_lt {n : ℕ} (schedule : Schedule n)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : i < schedule.steps) (hj : j < schedule.steps) (hij : i < j) :
    (schedule.windows.get ⟨i, hi⟩).left ≤ (schedule.windows.get ⟨j, hj⟩).left

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Schedule.right_le_of_get_lt

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Window.card_indexFinset
statement:
theorem Window.card_indexFinset {n : ℕ} (w : Window n) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Window.indexFinset_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem Window.indexFinset_nonempty_iff {n : ℕ} (w : Window n) :

statement:
theorem Window.indices_eq_nil_iff {n : ℕ} (w : Window n) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Window.mem_indexFinset_iff

statement:
theorem pruneBack_append_prunedBack (stream : Stream α) (q : Deque) (i : ℕ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.pruneBack_index_ordered

theorem pruneBack_index_ordered (stream : Stream α) {q : Deque} {i : ℕ}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.pruneBack_prefix
statement:
theorem pruneBack_prefix (stream : Stream α) (q : Deque) (i : ℕ) :
    pruneBack stream q i <+: q

Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.push_value_decreasing

Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.pushAll_interval_preserves
statement:
theorem pushAll_interval_preserves {stream : Stream α} {left oldRight newRight : ℕ} {q : Deque}
    (hq : ValidAt stream left oldRight q) (hright : oldRight ≤ newRight)
    (hbound : newRight ≤ stream.length) (hwindow : left ≤ newRight) :
    ValidAt stream left newRight
      (pushAll stream q
        (List.range' (max oldRight left) (newRight - max oldRight left))).state

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.pushAll_range_preserves
statement:
theorem pushAll_range_preserves {stream : Stream α} {left start count : ℕ} {q : Deque}
    (hq : ValidAt stream left start q) (hleft : left ≤ start)
    (hbound : start + count ≤ stream.length) :
    ValidAt stream left (start + count)
      (pushAll stream q (List.range' start count)).state

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.push_succ_preserves
statement:
theorem push_succ_preserves {stream : Stream α} {left right : ℕ} {q : Deque}
    (hq : ValidAt stream left right q) (hleft : left ≤ right)
    (hbound : right < stream.length) :
    ValidAt stream left (right + 1) (push stream q right)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.update_initial_preserves
statement:
theorem update_initial_preserves (stream : Stream α) (window : Window stream.length) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.update_preserves
statement:
theorem update_preserves {stream : Stream α} {oldWindow newWindow : Window stream.length}
    {q : Deque} (hq : Valid stream oldWindow q)
    (hleft : oldWindow.left ≤ newWindow.left)
    (hright : oldWindow.right ≤ newWindow.right) :
    Valid stream newWindow (update stream oldWindow.right newWindow q).after

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.update_pushed
statement:
theorem update_pushed (stream : Stream α) (oldRight : ℕ)
    (window : Window stream.length) (q : Deque) :
    (update stream oldRight window q).pushed =
      List.range' (max oldRight window.left) (window.right - max oldRight window.left)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Valid.head_argmax
statement:
theorem Valid.head_argmax {stream : Stream α} {window : Window stream.length} {q : Deque}
    (hq : Valid stream window q) (hne : window.left < window.right) :
    ∃ head tail, q = head :: tail ∧ Active window head ∧
      ∀ i, Active window i → stream.value i ≤ stream.value head

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.Valid.head_value_eq_windowMax
Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.ValidAt.head_argmax
statement:
theorem ValidAt.head_argmax {stream : Stream α} {left right : ℕ} {q : Deque}
    (hq : ValidAt stream left right q) (hne : left < right) (hbound : right ≤ stream.length) :
    ∃ head tail, q = head :: tail ∧ ActiveAt left right head ∧ head < stream.length ∧
      ∀ i, ActiveAt left right i → i < stream.length → stream.value i ≤ stream.value head

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.windowValues_nonempty
statement:
theorem windowValues_nonempty (stream : Stream α) (window : Window stream.length)
    (hne : window.left < window.right) : (windowValues stream window).Nonempty

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.length_scan
statement:

theorem scan_head_argmax (stream : Stream α) (schedule : Schedule stream.length)

      (schedule.windows.get ⟨k, hk⟩).right) :
    ∃ step head tail,
      (scan stream schedule)[k]? = some step ∧
      step.window = schedule.windows.get ⟨k, hk⟩ ∧

theorem active_schedule_iff (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) {k i : ℕ}
    (hk : k < steps.length) (hi : i < keys.length) :
    Active (P.schedule.windows.get ⟨k, by simpa [schedule, Schedule.steps] using hk⟩) i ↔
      P.entry (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get ⟨i, hi⟩) ∧
        P.stay (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get ⟨i, hi⟩)

    Active (P.windowAt s) i ↔

statement:
theorem drop_leftEndpoint_eq_dropWhile (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) (s : κ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.PredicateWindowSchedule.leftEndpoint_eq_add_newlyExpired
statement:
theorem leftEndpoint_eq_add_newlyExpired (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) (s t : κ)
    (hentry : ∀ x ∈ keys, P.entry s x → P.entry t x)
    (hstay : ∀ x ∈ keys, P.stay t x → P.stay s x) :
    P.leftEndpoint t = P.leftEndpoint s +
      (((keys.take (P.rightEndpoint t)).drop (P.leftEndpoint s)).takeWhile
        (P.expiredTest t)).length

statement:
theorem newlyEntering_eq_drop_entered (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) (s t : κ)
    (hentry : ∀ x ∈ keys, P.entry s x → P.entry t x) :
    (keys.drop (P.rightEndpoint s)).takeWhile (P.entryTest t) =
      (P.entered t).drop (P.rightEndpoint s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.PredicateWindowSchedule.newlyExpired_eq_takeWhile
statement:
theorem newlyExpired_eq_takeWhile (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) (s t : κ)
    (hentry : ∀ x ∈ keys, P.entry s x → P.entry t x)
    (hstay : ∀ x ∈ keys, P.stay t x → P.stay s x) :
    ((keys.take (P.rightEndpoint t)).drop (P.leftEndpoint s)).take
        (P.leftEndpoint t - P.leftEndpoint s) =
      ((keys.take (P.rightEndpoint t)).drop (P.leftEndpoint s)).takeWhile
        (P.expiredTest t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.rawScan_head_argmax
statement:
theorem rawScan_head_argmax [LinearOrder α]
    (P : PredicateWindowSchedule keys steps) (score : ι → α) (fallback : α)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < steps.length)
    (hne : ∃ i : Fin keys.length,
      P.entry (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i) ∧
        P.stay (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i)) :
    ∃ (trace : RawStepTrace ι κ) (head : ι) (tail : List ι)
        (headPos : Fin keys.length),
      (P.rawScan score)[k]? = some trace ∧
      trace.step = steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩ ∧
      trace.after = head :: tail ∧
      head = keys.get headPos ∧
      P.entry (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) head ∧
      P.stay (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) head ∧
      (∀ i : Fin keys.length,
        P.entry (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i) →
        P.stay (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i) →
        score (keys.get i) ≤ score head) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin keys.length,
        P.entry (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i) →
        P.stay (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) (keys.get i) →
        score (keys.get i) = score head → i.1 ≤ headPos.1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Algorithms.SlidingWindow.MonotoneDeque.rawScan_memory_le_windowWidth
statement:
theorem rawScan_memory_le_windowWidth [LinearOrder α]

    ∃ trace, (P.rawScan score)[k]? = some trace ∧

        P.rightEndpoint (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩) - P.leftEndpoint (steps.get ⟨k, hk⟩)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.affineDenominator_reciprocal_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem affineDenominator_reciprocal_eq_tsum
    {α : Type*} {a b : α → ℝ} {t t₀ : ℝ} {x : α}
    (hden : affineDenominator a b t₀ x ≠ 0)
    (hsmall :
      |(t - t₀) * (b x - a x) / affineDenominator a b t₀ x| < 1) :
    (affineDenominator a b t x)⁻¹ =
      ∑' n : ℕ,
        ((-(b x - a x) / affineDenominator a b t₀ x) ^ n /
          affineDenominator a b t₀ x) * (t - t₀) ^ n

statement:
theorem affineDenominator_slope_div_le_inv_radius
    {α : Type*} {K : Set α} {a b : α → ℝ} {t₀ ε r : ℝ}

    (hden : ∀ t, |t - t₀| < r → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε ≤ |affineDenominator a b t x|) :
    ∀ x ∈ K,
      |(b x - a x) / affineDenominator a b t₀ x| ≤ r⁻¹

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.affineDenominator_uniformly_nonzero_near
statement:
theorem affineDenominator_uniformly_nonzero_near
    {α : Type*} {K : Set α} {a b : α → ℝ} {t₀ ε L : ℝ}

    (hden : ∀ x ∈ K, ε ≤ |affineDenominator a b t₀ x|)
    (hslope : ∀ x ∈ K, |b x - a x| ≤ L) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ t, |t - t₀| < r → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ε / 2 ≤ |affineDenominator a b t x|

statement:
theorem affineDenominator_uniformly_nonzero_near_of_slope_div_bound
    {α : Type*} {K : Set α} {a b : α → ℝ} {t₀ ε Q : ℝ}

    (hratio : ∀ x ∈ K,
      |(b x - a x) / affineDenominator a b t₀ x| ≤ Q) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.affineDenominator_uniformly_nonzero_on_open_near
statement:
theorem affineDenominator_uniformly_nonzero_on_open_near
    {α : Type*} {K : Set α} {a b : α → ℝ} {O : Set ℝ} {ε : ℝ}

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.analyticAt_integral_of_powerSeries_domination
statement:
theorem analyticAt_integral_of_powerSeries_domination
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : ℝ → α → ℝ) (c : ℕ → α → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ)
    (t₀ r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hc : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (c n) μ)
    (hM : ∀ n, 0 ≤ M n)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖c n x‖ ≤ M n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n ↦ M n * r ^ n))
    (hseries : ∀ t, |t - t₀| < r →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f t x = ∑' n : ℕ, c n x * (t - t₀) ^ n) :
    AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t ↦ ∫ x, f t x ∂μ) t₀

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.integral_eq_tsum_of_powerSeries_domination
statement:
theorem integral_eq_tsum_of_powerSeries_domination
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : ℝ → α → ℝ) (c : ℕ → α → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ)
    (t₀ r t : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (ht : |t - t₀| < r)
    (hc : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (c n) μ)
    (hM : ∀ n, 0 ≤ M n)
    (hbound : ∀ n, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖c n x‖ ≤ M n)
    (hsum : Summable (fun n ↦ M n * r ^ n))
    (hseries : ∀ s, |s - t₀| < r →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f s x = ∑' n : ℕ, c n x * (s - t₀) ^ n) :
    ∫ x, f t x ∂μ = ∑' n : ℕ, (∫ x, c n x ∂μ) * (t - t₀) ^ n

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.ParametricRationalIntegralAnalyticity.analyticAt_setIntegral_polynomial_div_affine
statement:
theorem analyticAt_setIntegral_polynomial_div_affine
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α)
    {K : Set α} (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hμK : μ K ≠ ∞)

      = Real.sqrt (Q₀ ^ 2 + q ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.AbsoluteValueMomentPriorDuality.uniformApproxErrorAbs_eq_sSup
statement:
theorem uniformApproxErrorAbs_eq_sSup (p : Polynomial ℝ) :

      sSup ((fun x : ℝ => abs (abs x - p.eval x)) '' Set.Icc (-1) 1)

    uniformApproxErrorAbs p ≤ e ↔
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, abs (abs x - p.eval x) ≤ e

statement:
lemma fejerMean_fourier_nat (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.AbsoluteValueMomentPriorDuality.FejerCertificate.fejer_integrand_expand
statement:
lemma fejer_integrand_expand (n k : ℕ) (t : AddCircle Real.pi) :
    (fejerKernel n t : ℂ) * fourier (k : ℤ) t =
      (n : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n,
        fourier ((r : ℤ) - (s : ℤ) + (k : ℤ)) t

lemma fourier_comp_circleDouble (j : ℤ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.AbsoluteValueMomentPriorDuality.FejerCertificate.fourier_pair_eq
statement:
lemma fourier_pair_eq (A B : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (((A : ℂ) - B * Complex.I) / 2) * fourier (k : ℤ) (t : AddCircle Real.pi) +
      (((A : ℂ) + B * Complex.I) / 2) * fourier (-(k : ℤ)) (t : AddCircle Real.pi) =
      ((A * Real.cos (2 * k * t) + B * Real.sin (2 * k * t) : ℝ) : ℂ)

lemma absChebPoly_eval (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_coeff_le
statement:
theorem absChebPoly_coeff_le (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (k : ℕ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_eq
statement:
theorem absChebPoly_eq (m : ℕ) :
    absChebPoly m = C (2 / Real.pi) +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        C ((4 / Real.pi) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j /
          (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) *
          Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (2 * (j + 1) : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_eq_sum_Icc
statement:
theorem absChebPoly_eq_sum_Icc (m : ℕ) :
    absChebPoly m = C (2 / Real.pi) +
      ∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m,
        C ((4 / Real.pi) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ (v + 1) / (4 * (v : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)) *
          Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (2 * v : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_error_le
statement:
theorem absChebPoly_error_le (m : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    abs ((absChebPoly m).eval x - abs x) ≤ 2 / (Real.pi * (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_eval
statement:
theorem absChebPoly_eval (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    (absChebPoly m).eval x = 2 / Real.pi +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (4 / Real.pi) * (-1 : ℝ) ^ j *
          (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (2 * (j + 1) : ℕ)).eval x /
            (4 * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_halfDegree_coeff_le
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AbsoluteValue.absChebPoly_halfDegree_error_le
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.tensorConvolution_approx_lipschitz
statement:
theorem tensorConvolution_approx_lipschitz {d K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (normalizedCube d))
    (hlip : ∀ x ∈ normalizedCube d, ∀ y ∈ normalizedCube d,
      |f x - f y| ≤ L * ∑ i, |x i - y i|)
    (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |tensorConvolution K f x - f (cosPoint x)| ≤ 32 * (d : ℝ) * L / (K : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.tensorConvolution_exists_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem tensorConvolution_exists_mvPolynomial {d K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (normalizedCube d)) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ,
      (∀ x : Fin d → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) p = tensorConvolution K f x) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ d * (2 * (K - 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.mvCoeffL1_le_bounded
statement:
theorem mvCoeffL1_le_bounded {d n : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hcoord : ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ n)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ normalizedCube d, |MvPolynomial.eval x p| ≤ B) :
    mvCoeffL1 p ≤ ((2 : ℝ) * (n + 1) ^ 2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ d * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.tensorConvolution_exists_mvPolynomial_four_coeffBound
statement:
theorem tensorConvolution_exists_mvPolynomial_four_coeffBound {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (normalizedCube 4))
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ normalizedCube 4, |f z| ≤ B) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ,
      (∀ x : Fin 4 → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) p = tensorConvolution K f x) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ 8 * (K - 1) ∧
      mvCoeffL1 p ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (40 * K + 20) * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.affineJackson_approx_four
statement:
theorem affineJackson_approx_four {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (centeredRectangle c r))
    (hlip : ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r, ∀ z ∈ centeredRectangle c r,
      |f y - f z| ≤ L * ∑ i, |(y i - z i) / r i|) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ,
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ 8 * (K - 1) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r,
        |MvPolynomial.eval y p - f y| ≤ 128 * L / (K : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.affineJackson_coeffBound_four
statement:
theorem affineJackson_coeffBound_four {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (centeredRectangle c r))
    (hbound : ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r, |f y| ≤ B) :
    ∃ p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ,
      (∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y p = MvPolynomial.eval (normalizedPoint c r y) q) ∧
      (∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) q =
        tensorConvolution K (fun z => f (affinePoint c r z)) x) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ 8 * (K - 1) ∧
      mvCoeffL1 p ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (40 * K + 20) * B *
        ∏ i : Fin 4, (max 1 ((1 + |c i|) / r i)) ^ (2 * (K - 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.affineJackson_exists_mvPolynomial_four
statement:
theorem affineJackson_exists_mvPolynomial_four {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (centeredRectangle c r)) :
    ∃ p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ,
      (∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y p = MvPolynomial.eval (normalizedPoint c r y) q) ∧
      (∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) q =
        tensorConvolution K (fun z => f (affinePoint c r z)) x) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ 8 * (K - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.mvPolynomial_affine_substitution_four
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_affine_substitution_four
    (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ) (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (hqcoord : ∀ m ∈ q.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ n) :

      (∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y p = MvPolynomial.eval (normalizedPoint c r y) q) ∧

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AffineFourBoundary.affineJackson_boundary_adaptive_four
statement:
theorem affineJackson_boundary_adaptive_four {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (centeredRectangle c r))
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hlip : ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r, ∀ z ∈ centeredRectangle c r,
      |f y - f z| ≤ L * ∑ i, |y i - z i|)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ)
    (hpeval : ∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y p =
      MvPolynomial.eval (normalizedPoint c r y) q)
    (hqeval : ∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) q =
      tensorConvolution K (fun z => f (affinePoint c r z)) x)
    (y : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hy : y ∈ centeredRectangle c r) :
    |MvPolynomial.eval y p - f y| ≤
      32 * L * ∑ i : Fin 4,
        (Real.sqrt ((y i - (c i - r i)) * ((c i + r i) - y i)) / (K : ℝ) +
          r i / (K : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AffineFourBoundary.affineJackson_boundary_exists_four
statement:
theorem affineJackson_boundary_exists_four {K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (c r : Fin 4 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 < r i)
    (f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (centeredRectangle c r))
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hlip : ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r, ∀ z ∈ centeredRectangle c r,
      |f y - f z| ≤ L * ∑ i, |y i - z i|) :
    ∃ p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ,
      (∀ y, MvPolynomial.eval y p =
        MvPolynomial.eval (normalizedPoint c r y) q) ∧
      (∀ x, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) q =
        tensorConvolution K (fun z => f (affinePoint c r z)) x) ∧
      (∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ i, m i ≤ 2 * (K - 1)) ∧
      p.totalDegree ≤ 8 * (K - 1) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ centeredRectangle c r,
        |MvPolynomial.eval y p - f y| ≤
          32 * L * ∑ i : Fin 4,
            (Real.sqrt ((y i - (c i - r i)) * ((c i + r i) - y i)) /
              (K : ℝ) + r i / (K : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AffineFourBoundary.radius_mul_abs_sin_arccos_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem radius_mul_abs_sin_arccos_eq_boundary

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.AffineFourBoundary.tensorConvolution_boundary_adaptive
statement:
theorem tensorConvolution_boundary_adaptive {d K : ℕ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (g : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (hg : ContinuousOn g (normalizedCube d))
    (r : Fin d → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 0 ≤ r i)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hlip : ∀ x ∈ normalizedCube d, ∀ z ∈ normalizedCube d,
      |g x - g z| ≤ L * ∑ i, r i * |x i - z i|)
    (theta : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |tensorConvolution K g theta - g (cosPoint theta)| ≤
      L * ∑ i : Fin d,
        (32 * r i * |Real.sin (theta i)| / (K : ℝ) +
          32 * r i / (K : ℝ) ^ 2)

statement:
theorem czTrig_arccos_lipschitz (R : Polynomial ℝ) (β : ℕ) (hβ : R.natDegree ≤ β)
    (hM : 0 < czSup R) {s t : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    |Real.arccos (czTrig R t / czSup R) - Real.arccos (czTrig R s / czSup R)|
      ≤ (β : ℝ) * |t - s|

statement:

    (hβ : R.natDegree ≤ β) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {s t : ℝ}
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) :
    |Real.arccos (czTrig R t / (czSup R + δ)) -
        Real.arccos (czTrig R s / (czSup R + δ))| ≤
      (β : ℝ) * |t - s|

    (hmax : czTrig R t₀ = czSup R) (hclose : (β : ℝ) * |t₀ - s| ≤ Real.pi / 2) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.adjacentPairProduct_chebyshevPairedChordList
statement:
theorem adjacentPairProduct_chebyshevPairedChordList
    (L : ℕ) (θ y : ℝ) :

      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range L,
        4 * ‖((Real.cos θ - chebyshevZero L k : ℝ) : ℂ) +
          (y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ^ 2

statement:

statement:

theorem angularConvolution_cosine_expansion {n : ℕ} {g h : ℝ → ℝ}

    (hexp : ∀ t : ℝ,
      h t = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * t)) (θ : ℝ) :
    angularConvolution g h θ =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (a j * ∫ t in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, g t * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * t)) *

theorem exists_cosine_approximant {k : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} {γ H : ℝ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hγ : 0 < γ) (hγ1 : γ ≤ 1) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hholder : HasHolderBound f γ H) :
    ∃ p : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧ InCosineSpan k p ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, |f x - p x| ≤ 5 * H * (k : ℝ) ^ (-γ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.CosineProjection.cosineProjection_bestApproximation
statement:
theorem cosineProjection_bestApproximation {f p : ℝ → ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (hp : ContinuousOn p (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) (hspan : InCosineSpan k p) :
    l2Norm (fun x => f x - cosineProjection k f x) ≤ l2Norm (fun x => f x - p x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.CosineProjection.cosineProjection_pythagoras
statement:
theorem cosineProjection_pythagoras {f : ℝ → ℝ} (k : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) :
    (∫ x, |f x - cosinePolynomial k a x| ^ 2 ∂uniformMeasure) =
      (∫ x, |f x - cosineProjection k f x| ^ 2 ∂uniformMeasure) +
      (∫ x, |cosineProjection k f x - cosinePolynomial k a x| ^ 2 ∂uniformMeasure)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.CosineProjection.cosineProjection_error_le
statement:
theorem cosineProjection_error_le {f : ℝ → ℝ} {γ H : ℝ} {k : ℕ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.CosineProjection.cosineProjection_error_le_seminorm
statement:
theorem cosineProjection_error_le_seminorm {f : ℝ → ℝ} {γ : ℝ} {k : ℕ}
