      5 * holderSeminorm f γ * ENNReal.ofReal ((k : ℝ) ^ (-γ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.abs_eval_derivative_le_chebyshev_endpoint_of_root_control
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_le_chebyshev_endpoint_of_root_control
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L)
    (hroots : ∀ z : ℝ,
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).eval z = 0 →
        |Q.derivative.eval z| ≤
          |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval z|)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1)
    (hvertical : ∀ y : ℝ,
      ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
          ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
          ((1 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :
    |Q.derivative.eval x| ≤
      |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval 1|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.exists_chebyshevRootReflection
statement:
theorem exists_chebyshevRootReflection
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L)
    (hroots : ∀ z : ℝ,
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).eval z = 0 →
        |Q.derivative.eval z| ≤
          |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval z|)
    (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : Polynomial ℂ,
      R.natDegree ≤ L ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ,
        ‖R.eval ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ =
          ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
            ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) ∧
      |Q.derivative.eval x| ≤ ‖R.derivative.eval 0‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.norm_eval_derivative_zero_le_chebyshev_endpoint_of_vertical
statement:
theorem norm_eval_derivative_zero_le_chebyshev_endpoint_of_vertical
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (R : Polynomial ℂ) (hR : R.natDegree ≤ L)
    (hvertical : ∀ y : ℝ,
      ‖R.eval ((y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
        ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
          ((1 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :
    ‖R.derivative.eval 0‖ ≤
      |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval 1|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.abs_eval_derivative_le_chebyshev_at_root
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_le_chebyshev_at_root
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L)
    (hnodes : ∀ i, i ≤ L →
      |Q.eval (Polynomial.Chebyshev.node L i)| ≤ 1)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).eval x = 0) :
    |Q.derivative.eval x| ≤
      |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval x|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_of_chebyshev_root_control
statement:
theorem abs_eval_derivative_le_sq_of_chebyshev_root_control
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L)
    (hroots : ∀ z : ℝ,
      (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).eval z = 0 →
        |Q.derivative.eval z| ≤
          |(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (L : ℤ)).derivative.eval z|)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) :
    |Q.derivative.eval x| ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.duffinSchaeffer_derivative_le
statement:
theorem duffinSchaeffer_derivative_le
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hnodes : ∀ i, i ≤ L →
      |Q.eval (Polynomial.Chebyshev.node L i)| ≤ C)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) :
    |Q.derivative.eval x| ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.eval_derivative_eq_sum_chebyshevDerivativeWeight
statement:
theorem eval_derivative_eq_sum_chebyshevDerivativeWeight
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) {L : ℕ} (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L) (x : ℝ) :
    Q.derivative.eval x =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (L + 1),
        Q.eval (Polynomial.Chebyshev.node L i) * chebyshevDerivativeWeight L x i

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.norm_eval_chebyshev_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_rootProduct
statement:
theorem norm_eval_chebyshev_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_rootProduct
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
        ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ =
      ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).leadingCoeff‖ *
        ∏ k ∈ Finset.range L,
          ‖((x - chebyshevZero L k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.norm_eval_chebyshev_le_endpoint_vertical
statement:
theorem norm_eval_chebyshev_le_endpoint_vertical
    {L : ℕ} {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
        ((x : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤
      ‖(Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℂ (L : ℤ)).eval
        ((1 : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.prod_norm_sub_chebyshevZero_le_endpoint
statement:
theorem prod_norm_sub_chebyshevZero_le_endpoint
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) (y : ℝ) :
    (∏ k ∈ Finset.range L,
        ‖((x - chebyshevZero L k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖) ≤
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range L,
        ‖((1 - chebyshevZero L k : ℝ) : ℂ) + (y : ℂ) * Complex.I‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.sum_abs_chebyshevDerivativeWeight_le_sq
statement:
theorem sum_abs_chebyshevDerivativeWeight_le_sq
    {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1) 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (L + 1), |chebyshevDerivativeWeight L x i| ≤
      (L : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedDistance_erase_split
statement:
theorem equispacedDistance_erase_split (D : ℕ) (j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    (∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (D + 1))).erase j,
      |(j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ)|) =
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (j : ℕ), ((j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ))) *
        (∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico ((j : ℕ) + 1) (D + 1), ((i : ℝ) - (j : ℝ)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedDistance_lower_factorial
statement:
theorem equispacedDistance_lower_factorial (j : ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.range j, ((j : ℝ) - (i : ℝ))) = (j.factorial : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedDistance_upper_factorial
statement:
theorem equispacedDistance_upper_factorial (D : ℕ) (j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    (∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico ((j : ℕ) + 1) (D + 1), ((i : ℝ) - (j : ℝ))) =
      ((D - (j : ℕ)).factorial : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_basis_oneNorm
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_basis_oneNorm (D : ℕ) (j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    (∑ k : Fin (D + 1), |equispacedLagrangeWeight D k j|) ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ D * (D + 1 : ℝ) ^ D /
        (((j : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((D - (j : ℕ)).factorial : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_coeff_recovery
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_coeff_recovery (D : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hp : p.natDegree ≤ D) (k : Fin (D + 1)) :
    p.coeff k = ∑ j : Fin (D + 1),
      equispacedLagrangeWeight D k j * p.eval (equispacedLagrangeNode D j)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_denominator_abs
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_denominator_abs (D : ℕ) (j : Fin (D + 1)) :
    |∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (D + 1))).erase j,
      (equispacedLagrangeNode D j - equispacedLagrangeNode D i)| =
      (((j : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((D - (j : ℕ)).factorial : ℝ)) /
        (D + 1 : ℝ) ^ D

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_factorial_ratio_le
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_factorial_ratio_le (D : ℕ) :
    (D + 1 : ℝ) ^ D / (D.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ D

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_reciprocal_factorial_sum
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_reciprocal_factorial_sum (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (D + 1),
      1 / (((j : ℕ).factorial : ℝ) * ((D - (j : ℕ)).factorial : ℝ))) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ D / (D.factorial : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.equispacedLagrange_weight_oneNorm
statement:
theorem equispacedLagrange_weight_oneNorm (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ k : Fin (D + 1), ∑ j : Fin (D + 1),
      |equispacedLagrangeWeight D k j|) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * D + 4)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.convolution_shifted
statement:
theorem convolution_shifted (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ y ∈ cube, |f y| ≤ B) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    convolution d f x =
      ∫ v in periodBox, f (cosPoint v) * kernel d (x - v)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.integrableOn_convolution_integrand
statement:
theorem integrableOn_convolution_integrand (d : ι → ℕ)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x ∈ cube, |f x| ≤ B) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun u => f (cosPoint (x - u)) * kernel d u) periodBox

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.measurable_convolution
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_convolution (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (x : ι → ℝ) : Measurable (fun ω => convolution d (g ω) x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.periodBox_integral_sub_eq
statement:
theorem periodBox_integral_sub_eq (F : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hF : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ y, |F y| ≤ B)
    (hper : ∀ i y,
      Function.Periodic (fun t => F (Function.update y i t)) (2 * Real.pi))
    (x : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ u in periodBox, F (x - u)) = ∫ u in periodBox, F u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.periodBox_integral_sub_eq_fin
statement:
theorem periodBox_integral_sub_eq_fin (n : ℕ) (F : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hF : Measurable F) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ y, |F y| ≤ B)
    (hper : ∀ i y,
      Function.Periodic (fun t => F (Function.update y i t)) (2 * Real.pi))
    (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∫ u in periodBox, F (x - u)) = ∫ u in periodBox, F u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.convolution_coord_even
statement:
theorem convolution_coord_even (d : ι → ℕ)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x ∈ cube, |f x| ≤ B)
    (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    Function.Even (fun t => convolution d f (Function.update x i t))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.convolution_coord_trig
statement:
theorem convolution_coord_trig (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : Measurable f)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x ∈ cube, |f x| ≤ B)
    (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.IsTrigPolyLE (2 * (d i - 1))
      (fun t => convolution d f (Function.update x i t))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.convolution_exists_polynomial
statement:
theorem convolution_exists_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : Measurable f)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x ∈ cube, |f x| ≤ B) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ,
      (∀ x : ι → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) p = convolution d f x) ∧
      (∀ γ ∈ p.support, ∀ i, γ i ≤ 2 * (d i - 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.polynomial_of_coord_even_trig
statement:
theorem polynomial_of_coord_even_trig (d : ι → ℕ) (q : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (htrig : ∀ i x,
      Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.IsTrigPolyLE (2 * (d i - 1))
        (fun t => q (Function.update x i t)))
    (heven : ∀ i x, Function.Even (fun t => q (Function.update x i t))) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ,
      (∀ x : ι → ℝ, MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) p = q x) ∧
      (∀ γ ∈ p.support, ∀ i, γ i ≤ 2 * (d i - 1))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.continuous_tensorCoeffs_of_grid
statement:
theorem continuous_tensorCoeffs_of_grid {Λ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Λ]
    {d D : ℕ} (p : Λ → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ s i, (p s).degreeOf i ≤ D)
    (hgrid : ∀ a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1),
      Continuous (fun s => MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (a i : ℝ)) (p s)))
    (a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1)) :
    Continuous (fun s => tensorCoeffs (D := D) (p s) a)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.measurable_tensorCoeffs_of_grid
statement:
theorem measurable_tensorCoeffs_of_grid {Λ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Λ]
    [MeasurableSpace Λ] [BorelSpace Λ] {d D : ℕ}
    (p : Λ → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ s i, (p s).degreeOf i ≤ D)
    (hgrid : ∀ a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1),
      Continuous (fun s => MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (a i : ℝ)) (p s)))
    (a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1)) :
    Measurable (fun s => tensorCoeffs (D := D) (p s) a)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorCoeffs_l1_le_cube_bound
statement:
theorem tensorCoeffs_l1_le_cube_bound {d D : ℕ}
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ normalizedCube d, |MvPolynomial.eval x p| ≤ B) :
    mvCoeffL1 p ≤ ((2 : ℝ) * (D + 1) ^ 2 * (3 : ℝ) ^ D) ^ d * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorPolynomial_eq_of_grid
statement:
theorem tensorPolynomial_eq_of_grid {d D : ℕ}
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D) (hq : ∀ i, q.degreeOf i ≤ D)
    (hgrid : ∀ a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1),
      MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (a i : ℝ)) p =
        MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (a i : ℝ)) q) : p = q

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorPolynomial_tensorCoeffs
statement:
theorem tensorPolynomial_tensorCoeffs {d D : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D) :
    tensorPolynomial (tensorCoeffs (D := D) p) = p

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorGridPoint_mem_cube
statement:
theorem tensorGridPoint_mem_cube {d D : ℕ} (b : Fin d → Fin (D + 1)) :
    tensorGridPoint b ∈ normalizedCube d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorGrid_coeff_recovery
statement:
theorem tensorGrid_coeff_recovery {d D : ℕ} (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D) (a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1)) :
    tensorCoeffs (D := D) p a =
      ∑ b : Fin d → Fin (D + 1),
        tensorGridWeight a b * MvPolynomial.eval (tensorGridPoint b) p

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorGrid_weight_oneNorm_le
statement:
theorem tensorGrid_weight_oneNorm_le (d D : ℕ) :
    (∑ a : Fin d → Fin (D + 1),
      ∑ b : Fin d → Fin (D + 1), |tensorGridWeight a b|) ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (4 * D + 4)) ^ d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.coeff_interpolate
statement:
theorem coeff_interpolate (d : ι → ℕ) (v : GridIndex d → ℝ)
    (a : GridIndex d) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (exponent d a) (interpolate d v) =
      ∑ b : GridIndex d, gridWeight d a b * v b

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.coeff_interpolate_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_interpolate_eq_zero (d : ι → ℕ) (v : GridIndex d → ℝ)
    (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) (hγ : ∃ i, interpolationDegree d < γ i) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff γ (interpolate d v) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.interpolate_eval
statement:
theorem interpolate_eval (d : ι → ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial ι ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ interpolationDegree d) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval x
      (interpolate d (fun b => MvPolynomial.eval (gridPoint d b) p)) =
      MvPolynomial.eval x p

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.convolution_even
statement:
theorem convolution_even (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ) :
    convolution N (-j) = convolution N j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.convolution_support
statement:
theorem convolution_support (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ)
    (hj : ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |j|) : convolution N j = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.convolution_zero
statement:
theorem convolution_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    convolution N 0 = (2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 3 + N) / 3

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.convolution_zero_pos
statement:
theorem convolution_zero_pos (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    0 < convolution N 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.cosine_coefficient_even_finite
statement:
theorem cosine_coefficient_even_finite (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ k : ℤ, k ∈ s ↔ -k ∈ s)
    (ha : ∀ k : ℤ, a (-k) = a k) (j : ℤ) :
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
      ∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
        (∑ k ∈ s, a k * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * u)) *
          Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u) =
      if j ∈ s then a j else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.cosine_mode_orthogonality
statement:
theorem cosine_mode_orthogonality (k j : ℤ) :
    (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
      ∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
        Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * u) * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u) =
      if k = 0 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else if |k| = |j| then 1 / 2 else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.finite_cosine_square_of_even
statement:
theorem finite_cosine_square_of_even (s : Finset ℤ) (a : ℤ → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ k : ℤ, k ∈ s ↔ -k ∈ s) (ha : ∀ k : ℤ, a (-k) = a k)
    (u : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, a k * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * u)) ^ 2 =
      ∑ k ∈ s, ∑ l ∈ s,
        a k * a l * Real.cos (((k + l : ℤ) : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.kernelCoeff_eq_normalizedCoeff
statement:
theorem kernelCoeff_eq_normalizedCoeff (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (j : ℤ) :
    kernelCoeff N j = normalizedCoeff N j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.kernel_fourier
statement:
theorem kernel_fourier (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    kernel N u =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        normalizedCoeff N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.kernel_normalized_integral
statement:
theorem kernel_normalized_integral (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, kernel N u / (2 * Real.pi)) = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.normalizedCoeff_support
statement:
theorem normalizedCoeff_support (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ)
    (hj : ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |j|) : normalizedCoeff N j = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.raw_kernel_fourier
statement:
theorem raw_kernel_fourier (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.JacksonApproximation.jraw N u =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        convolution N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_fourier
statement:
theorem triangle_fourier (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    ((Polynomial.Chebyshev.U ℝ ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval
      (Real.cos (u / 2))) ^ 2 =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
        triangle N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_fourier_square
statement:
theorem triangle_fourier_square (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
      triangle N k * Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * u)) ^ 2 =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        convolution N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_pair_sum_eq_convolution
statement:
theorem triangle_pair_sum_eq_convolution (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ)) (N : ℤ),
        triangle N k * triangle N l *
          Real.cos (((k + l : ℤ) : ℝ) * u)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        convolution N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_support
statement:
theorem triangle_support (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ) (hj : (N : ℤ) ≤ |j|) :
    triangle N j = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.delta2_convolution
statement:
theorem delta2_convolution (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ) :
    delta2 (convolution N) j =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ) - 1) (N : ℤ),
        delta (triangle N) k * delta (triangle N) (j - k)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.delta_convolution
statement:
theorem delta_convolution (N : ℕ) (j : ℤ) :
    delta (convolution N) j =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc (-(N : ℤ) - 1) (N : ℤ),
        delta (triangle N) k * triangle N (j - k)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.finite_convolution_l1
statement:
theorem finite_convolution_l1 (a b : ℤ → ℝ)
    (ha : Function.HasFiniteSupport a) (hb : Function.HasFiniteSupport b) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |∑' k : ℤ, a k * b (j - k)|) ≤
      (∑' k : ℤ, |a k|) * (∑' l : ℤ, |b l|)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.finite_convolution_tsum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finite_convolution_tsum_eq_sum (a b : ℤ → ℝ) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (ha : ∀ k ∉ s, a k = 0) (j : ℤ) :
    (∑' k : ℤ, a k * b (j - k)) = ∑ k ∈ s, a k * b (j - k)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.normalizedCoeff_delta2_l1
statement:
theorem normalizedCoeff_delta2_l1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |delta2 (normalizedCoeff N) j|) ≤ 6 / (N : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.normalizedCoeff_delta_l1
statement:
theorem normalizedCoeff_delta_l1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |delta (normalizedCoeff N) j|) ≤ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.normalizedCoeff_l1
statement:
theorem normalizedCoeff_l1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |normalizedCoeff N j|) ≤ 2 * (N : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_delta_l1
statement:
theorem triangle_delta_l1 (N : ℕ) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |delta (triangle N) j|) = 2 * (N : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.triangle_l1
statement:
theorem triangle_l1 (N : ℕ) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |triangle N j|) = (N : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.normalizedCoeff_l1_lower
statement:
theorem normalizedCoeff_l1_lower (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (N : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ∑' j : ℤ, |normalizedCoeff N j|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.delta2_mul
statement:
theorem delta2_mul (f q : ℤ → ℝ) (j : ℤ) :
    delta2 (fun k => f k * q k) j =
      f (j + 2) * delta2 q j +
      (delta f (j + 1) + delta f j) * delta q j +
      q (j + 1) * delta2 f j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.reciprocalSquare_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalSquare_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (j : ℤ) (hj : |j| ≤ (2 * N : ℕ)) :
    |reciprocalSquare N σ j| ≤ 1 / (N : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.reciprocalSquare_delta2_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalSquare_delta2_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (j : ℤ) (hj : |j| ≤ (2 * N : ℕ)) :
    |delta2 (reciprocalSquare N σ) j| ≤ 64 / (N : ℝ) ^ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.reciprocalSquare_delta_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalSquare_delta_bound (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (j : ℤ) (hj : |j| ≤ (2 * N : ℕ)) :
    |delta (reciprocalSquare N σ) j| ≤ 16 / (N : ℝ) ^ 3

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.weightedCoeff_delta2_l1
statement:
theorem weightedCoeff_delta2_l1 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (σ : ℝ)
    (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) :
    (∑' j : ℤ, |delta2 (weightedCoeff N σ) j|) ≤ 512 / (N : ℝ) ^ 3

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.weightedCoeff_support
statement:
theorem weightedCoeff_support (N : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (j : ℤ)
    (hj : ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) < |j|) : weightedCoeff N σ j = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.finiteFourier_twice_summation_by_parts
statement:
theorem finiteFourier_twice_summation_by_parts (a : ℤ → ℂ)
    (ha : Function.HasFiniteSupport a) (u : ℝ) :
    finiteFourier (complexDelta2 a) u =
      (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (u : ℂ)) - 1) ^ 2 * finiteFourier a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_kernel_reconstruction
statement:
theorem packet_kernel_reconstruction (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (u : ℝ) :
    kernel N u =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc (-((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ((2 * N - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ),
        normalizedCoeff N j * Real.cos ((j : ℝ) * u)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_zero_mean
statement:
theorem packet_zero_mean (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) :
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, packetAntideriv N u) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_center_bounds
statement:
theorem packet_center_bounds :
    ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ c ≤ C ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N →
        c / (N : ℝ) ≤ |packetAntideriv N 0| ∧
        |packetAntideriv N 0| ≤ C / (N : ℝ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_twice_deriv
statement:
theorem packet_twice_deriv (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (u : ℝ) :
    deriv (deriv (packetAntideriv N)) u = packetOscillation N u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packetAntideriv_eq_finiteFourier
statement:
theorem packetAntideriv_eq_finiteFourier (N : ℕ) (u : ℝ) :
    packetAntideriv N u = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ((Complex.exp (Complex.I * (4 * (N : ℝ) * u : ℂ)) *
          finiteFourier (fun j => (packetCoeffPlus N j : ℂ)) u).re +
       (Complex.exp (Complex.I * (4 * (N : ℝ) * u : ℂ)) *
          finiteFourier (fun j => (packetCoeffMinus N j : ℂ)) (-u)).re)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.character_gap_ge_torusDistance
statement:
theorem character_gap_ge_torusDistance (u : ℝ) :
    2 / Real.pi * torusDistance u ≤
      ‖Complex.exp (-Complex.I * (u : ℂ)) - 1‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.torusDistance_bounds
statement:
theorem torusDistance_bounds (u : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ torusDistance u ∧ torusDistance u ≤ Real.pi

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.torusDistance_eq_abs
statement:
theorem torusDistance_eq_abs (u : ℝ) (hu : |u| ≤ Real.pi) :
    torusDistance u = |u|

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_l1_localization
statement:
theorem packet_l1_localization :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N →
        (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
          |packetAntideriv N u| / (2 * Real.pi)) ≤ C / (N : ℝ) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_pointwise_localization
statement:
theorem packet_pointwise_localization :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → ∀ u : ℝ,
        |packetAntideriv N u| ≤
          C / ((N : ℝ) * (1 + (N : ℝ) * torusDistance u) ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Jackson.packet_shifted_support
statement:
theorem packet_shifted_support (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (r : ℤ)
    (hr : |r| < (2 * N + 2 : ℕ) ∨ (6 * N - 2 : ℕ) < |r|) :
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
      packetOscillation N u * Real.cos ((r : ℝ) * u)) = 0 ∧
    (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
      packetOscillation N u * Real.sin ((r : ℝ) * u)) = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.derivative_eval_pullbackToUnitInterval
statement:
theorem derivative_eval_pullbackToUnitInterval
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (r s t : ℝ) :
    (pullbackToUnitInterval Q r s).derivative.eval t =
      ((s - r) / 2) * Q.derivative.eval
        (((s - r) / 2) * t + (r + s) / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.eval_pullbackToUnitInterval
statement:
theorem eval_pullbackToUnitInterval
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (r s t : ℝ) :
    (pullbackToUnitInterval Q r s).eval t =
      Q.eval (((s - r) / 2) * t + (r + s) / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.intervalSupNorm_pullbackToUnitInterval
statement:
theorem intervalSupNorm_pullbackToUnitInterval
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) {r s : ℝ} (hrs : r < s) :
    intervalSupNorm (fun t => (pullbackToUnitInterval Q r s).eval t) (-1) 1 =
      intervalSupNorm (fun x => Q.eval x) r s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.markov_derivative_Icc
statement:
theorem markov_derivative_Icc
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) {r s : ℝ} (hrs : r < s)
    (L : ℕ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L) :
    intervalSupNorm (fun x => Q.derivative.eval x) r s ≤
      (2 * (L : ℝ) ^ 2 / (s - r)) *
        intervalSupNorm (fun x => Q.eval x) r s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.markov_derivative_unitInterval
statement:
theorem markov_derivative_unitInterval
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (L : ℕ) (hQ : Q.natDegree ≤ L) :
    intervalSupNorm (fun x => Q.derivative.eval x) (-1) 1 ≤
      (L : ℝ) ^ 2 * intervalSupNorm (fun x => Q.eval x) (-1) 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.FinitePolynomialAlternationDuality.natDegree_pullbackToUnitInterval_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_pullbackToUnitInterval_le
    (Q : Polynomial ℝ) (r s : ℝ) :
    (pullbackToUnitInterval Q r s).natDegree ≤ Q.natDegree

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czMeshLHS_le_czSup
statement:
theorem czMeshLHS_le_czSup (R : Polynomial ℝ) :
    sSup ((fun x => |R.eval x|) '' Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) ≤ czSup R

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czMeshMax_neg
statement:
lemma czMeshMax_neg (R : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    czMeshMax (-R) k = czMeshMax R k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czMeshMax_nonneg
statement:
lemma czMeshMax_nonneg (R : Polynomial ℝ) (k : ℕ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czSup_neg
statement:
lemma czSup_neg (R : Polynomial ℝ) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czTrig_at_meshParam
statement:
theorem czTrig_at_meshParam (R : Polynomial ℝ) (k j : ℕ) :
    czTrig R (Real.pi * j / k) = R.eval (czNode k j)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.czTrig_neg
statement:
lemma czTrig_neg (R : Polynomial ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    czTrig (-R) t = -czTrig R t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.ehlichZeller_mesh_bound
statement:
theorem ehlichZeller_mesh_bound (R : Polynomial ℝ) (β k : ℕ)
    (hβ : R.natDegree ≤ β) (hk : β < k) :
    sSup ((fun x => |R.eval x|) '' Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
      ≤ (1 / Real.cos (Real.pi * β / (2 * k))) * czMeshMax R k

Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.EhlichZellerMesh.oversampled_norming
statement:
theorem oversampled_norming (R : Polynomial ℝ) (β k : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 1 < c) (hβ : 1 ≤ β) (hβR : R.natDegree ≤ β) (hk : (c * β) ≤ k) :
    sSup ((fun x => |R.eval x|) '' Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.coeff_polynomial
statement:
theorem coeff_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ) (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (ω : Ω) (a : GridIndex d) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (exponent d a) (polynomial d g ω) =
      ∑ b : GridIndex d, gridWeight d a b *
        convolution d (g ω) (fun i => Real.arccos (gridPoint d b i))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.eval_cosPoint_polynomial
statement:
theorem eval_cosPoint_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ ω x, x ∈ cube → |g ω x| ≤ B)
    (ω : Ω) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (cosPoint x) (polynomial d g ω) =
      convolution d (g ω) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.eval_polynomial
statement:
theorem eval_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ ω x, x ∈ cube → |g ω x| ≤ B)
    (ω : Ω) (θ : ι → ℝ) (hθ : θ ∈ cube) :
    MvPolynomial.eval θ (polynomial d g ω) =
      convolution d (g ω) (fun i => Real.arccos (θ i))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.measurable_coeff_polynomial
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_coeff_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => MvPolynomial.coeff γ (polynomial d g ω))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.measurable_coeff_sum
statement:
theorem measurable_coeff_sum (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (S : Finset (ι →₀ ℕ)) (w : (ι →₀ ℕ) → Ω → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ γ ∈ S, Measurable (w γ)) :
    Measurable (fun ω => ∑ γ ∈ S,
      MvPolynomial.coeff γ (polynomial d g ω) * w γ ω)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.measurable_eval_polynomial
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem measurable_eval_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (x : Ω → ι → ℝ) (hx : Measurable x) :
    Measurable (fun ω => MvPolynomial.eval (x ω) (polynomial d g ω))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.HeterogeneousTensor.support_polynomial
statement:
theorem support_polynomial (d : ι → ℕ) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i)
    (g : Ω → (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable (fun z : Ω × (ι → ℝ) => g z.1 z.2))
    (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ ω x, x ∈ cube → |g ω x| ≤ B)
    (ω : Ω) (γ : ι →₀ ℕ) (hγ : γ ∈ (polynomial d g ω).support) (i : ι) :
    γ i ≤ 2 * (d i - 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.intervalDecay_add_inv
statement:
theorem intervalDecay_add_inv {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    intervalDecay a b + (intervalDecay a b)⁻¹ = 2 * intervalShape a b

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.intervalDecay_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem intervalDecay_mem_Ioo {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    intervalDecay a b ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.intervalDecay_one_sq
statement:
theorem intervalDecay_one_sq (K : ℕ) (hK : 2 ≤ K) :
    intervalDecay 1 ((K : ℝ) ^ 2) = ((K : ℝ) - 1) / ((K : ℝ) + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.intervalShape_gt_one
statement:
theorem intervalShape_gt_one {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    1 < intervalShape a b

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalError_one_sq
statement:
theorem reciprocalError_one_sq (K : ℕ) (hK : 2 ≤ K) :
    reciprocalError 1 ((K : ℝ) ^ 2) K =
      (((K : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2)) *
        (((K : ℝ) - 1) / ((K : ℝ) + 1)) ^ K

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalError_pos
statement:
theorem reciprocalError_pos {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) :
    0 < reciprocalError a b m

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.exists_reciprocalAlternatingAngles
statement:
theorem exists_reciprocalAlternatingAngles
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : ρ ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ angles : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
      StrictMono angles ∧
      (∀ i, angles i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) Real.pi) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (m + 2), if Even (i : ℕ) then
        Real.sin (((m : ℝ) + 1) * angles i / 2) -
          ρ * Real.sin (((m : ℝ) - 1) * angles i / 2) = 0
      else
        Real.cos (((m : ℝ) + 1) * angles i / 2) -
          ρ * Real.cos (((m : ℝ) - 1) * angles i / 2) = 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.alternatingResidual_certifiesBest
statement:
theorem alternatingResidual_certifiesBest
    {f : ℝ → ℝ} {a b E : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hab : a < b) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hE : 0 ≤ E) (P : Polynomial ℝ) (hdegree : P.natDegree ≤ m)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x - P.eval x| ≤ E)
    (nodes : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ) (hmono : StrictMono nodes)
    (hmem : ∀ i, nodes i ∈ Set.Icc a b)
    (halt : ∀ i, f (nodes i) - P.eval (nodes i) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * E) :
    uniformApproxError f a b P = E ∧ bestUniformApproxError f a b m = E

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalApproxPoly_degree_le
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalApproxPoly_residual
statement:
theorem reciprocalApproxPoly_residual {a b z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hz : z ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    z⁻¹ - (reciprocalApproxPoly a b m).eval z =
      (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval
        (intervalShape a b - 2 * z / (b - a)) /
        (z * (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval (intervalShape a b))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_at_shape
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_at_shape {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) :
    (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval (intervalShape a b) =
      2 * ((intervalShape a b) ^ 2 - 1) / intervalDecay a b ^ m

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_degree_le
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_degree_le (a b : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).natDegree ≤ m + 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_cos_square
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_cos_square {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval (Real.cos θ) =
      -2 * (intervalShape a b - Real.cos θ) +
        (2 / intervalDecay a b) *
          (Real.cos (((m : ℝ) + 1) * θ / 2) -
            intervalDecay a b * Real.cos (((m : ℝ) - 1) * θ / 2)) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_sin_square
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_sin_square {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval (Real.cos θ) =
      2 * (intervalShape a b - Real.cos θ) -
        (2 / intervalDecay a b) *
          (Real.sin (((m : ℝ) + 1) * θ / 2) -
            intervalDecay a b * Real.sin (((m : ℝ) - 1) * θ / 2)) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_alternating_nodes
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_alternating_nodes {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ nodes : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
      StrictMono nodes ∧
      (∀ i, nodes i ∈ Set.Icc a b) ∧
      (∀ i,
        (reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval
          (intervalShape a b - 2 * nodes i / (b - a)) =
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) *
            (2 * (intervalShape a b -
              (intervalShape a b - 2 * nodes i / (b - a)))))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalResidualPoly_bound
statement:
theorem reciprocalResidualPoly_bound {a b z : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc a b) (m : ℕ) :
    |(reciprocalResidualPoly a b m).eval
      (intervalShape a b - 2 * z / (b - a))| ≤
      2 * (intervalShape a b -
        (intervalShape a b - 2 * z / (b - a)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.bestUniformApproxError_reciprocal
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.bestUniformApproxError_reciprocal_one_sq
statement:
theorem bestUniformApproxError_reciprocal_one_sq
    (K : ℕ) (hK : 2 ≤ K) :
    bestUniformApproxError (fun z : ℝ => z⁻¹) 1 ((K : ℝ) ^ 2) K =
      (((K : ℝ) ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * (K : ℝ) ^ 2)) *
        (((K : ℝ) - 1) / ((K : ℝ) + 1)) ^ K

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalApproxPoly_alternates
statement:
theorem reciprocalApproxPoly_alternates {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ nodes : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ,
      StrictMono nodes ∧
      (∀ i, nodes i ∈ Set.Icc a b) ∧
      (∀ i,
        (nodes i)⁻¹ - (reciprocalApproxPoly a b m).eval (nodes i) =
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * reciprocalError a b m)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.Reciprocal.reciprocalApproxPoly_upper
statement:
theorem reciprocalApproxPoly_upper {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (m : ℕ) :
    uniformApproxError (fun z : ℝ => z⁻¹) a b (reciprocalApproxPoly a b m) ≤
      reciprocalError a b m

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.chebyshev_one_variable_cosine_orthogonality
statement:
theorem chebyshev_one_variable_cosine_orthogonality (k m : ℕ) :
    (if k = 0 then (1 / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) else 1 / Real.pi) *
      (∫ u in Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
        Real.cos (k * u) *
          Polynomial.eval (Real.cos u) (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ (m : ℤ))) =
      if k = m then 1 else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.chebyshev_one_variable_finite_span
statement:
theorem chebyshev_one_variable_finite_span (D : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℝ)
    (hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ D) :
    ∃ c : Fin (D + 1) → ℝ,
      p = ∑ k : Fin (D + 1),
        Polynomial.C (c k) * Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshevBasis_coeff_factorization
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevBasis_coeff_factorization (D : ℕ)
    (k a : Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) :
    tensorCoeffs (D := D) (tensorChebyshevBasis D k) a =
      ∏ i : Fin 4,
        (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ ((k i : ℕ) : ℤ)).coeff (a i : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshevBasis_coeff_oneNorm_le
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevBasis_coeff_oneNorm_le (D : ℕ)
    (k : Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) :
    (∑ a : Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1),
      |tensorCoeffs (D := D) (tensorChebyshevBasis D k) a|) ≤
        (1 + Real.sqrt 2) ^ (4 * D)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshevBasis_finite_span
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevBasis_finite_span (D : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D) :
    ∃ c : (Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) → ℝ,
      p = tensorChebyshevPolynomial D c

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshevBasis_monomial_span
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevBasis_monomial_span (D : ℕ)
    (a : Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) :
    ∃ c : (Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) → ℝ,
      MvPolynomial.monomial (tensorExponent a) (1 : ℝ) =
        tensorChebyshevPolynomial D c

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshevCoefficient_basis
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshevCoefficient_basis (D : ℕ)
    (k m : Fin 4 → Fin (D + 1)) :
    tensorChebyshevCoefficient D (tensorChebyshevBasis D m) k =
      if k = m then 1 else 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorChebyshev_coeff_recovery
statement:
theorem tensorChebyshev_coeff_recovery (D : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) ℝ)
    (hdeg : ∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ D) :
    p = tensorChebyshevPolynomial D (tensorChebyshevCoefficient D p)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.bernoulliKL_eq_bregman
statement:
lemma bernoulliKL_eq_bregman {p q : ℝ}
    (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : 1 - p ≠ 0) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq1 : 1 - q ≠ 0) :
    p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 - p) * Real.log ((1 - p) / (1 - q)) =
      bernD p - bernD q - (Real.log q - Real.log (1 - q)) * (p - q)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.bernoulli_kl_le_four_sq_sub_of_mem_quarter_band
statement:
theorem bernoulli_kl_le_four_sq_sub_of_mem_quarter_band
    {p q : ℝ} (hp_lo : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ p) (hp_hi : p ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hq_lo : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ q) (hq_hi : q ≤ 3 / 4) :
    p * Real.log (p / q) + (1 - p) * Real.log ((1 - p) / (1 - q))
      ≤ 4 * (p - q) ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.hasDerivAt_bernEntropy
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bernEntropy (x : ℝ) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) (hx1 : 1 - x ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * Real.log t + (1 - t) * Real.log (1 - t))
      (Real.log x - Real.log (1 - x)) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.cubeAffine_contDiff
statement:
theorem cubeAffine_contDiff {d m : ℕ} :
    ContDiff ℝ m (cubeAffine : (Fin d → ℝ) → (Fin d → ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.cubeAffine_mem_cube
statement:
theorem cubeAffine_mem_cube {d : ℕ} {x : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ unitCube d) : cubeAffine x ∈ cube d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.cubeAffine_norm_sub
statement:
theorem cubeAffine_norm_sub {d : ℕ} (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ‖cubeAffine x - cubeAffine y‖ = 2 * ‖x - y‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.cubeAffine_preimage_cube
statement:
theorem cubeAffine_preimage_cube (d : ℕ) :
    cubeAffine ⁻¹' cube d = unitCube d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.ambient_jet_zero_or_within
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.cube_subset_closure_openCube
statement:
theorem cube_subset_closure_openCube (d : ℕ) :
    cube d ⊆ closure (openCube d)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.within_coordPartial_bound_extends
statement:
theorem within_coordPartial_bound_extends {d m j : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d)) (hj : j ≤ m)
    (f : Fin j → Fin d)
    (hinterior : ∀ x ∈ openCube d, |coordPartial j u f x| ≤ B) :
    ∀ x ∈ cube d,
      |iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j u (cube d) x
        (fun a => Pi.single (f a) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.continuousOn_coordJetOn_cube
statement:
theorem continuousOn_coordJetOn_cube {d m j : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    (hj : j ≤ m) (f : Fin j → Fin d) :
    ContinuousOn (coordJetOn (cube d) j u f) (cube d)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.coordJetOn_congr
statement:
theorem coordJetOn_congr {d j : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)}
    {u v : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (h : Set.EqOn u v S)
    {f : Fin j → Fin d} {x : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    coordJetOn S j u f x = coordJetOn S j v f x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.coordJetOn_cube_eq_ambient
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.holderBallOn_congr
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.cube_holder_affine_transport
statement:
theorem cube_holder_affine_transport (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
        CubeHolderBall d m s R u →
        HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s (C * R)
          (fun x => u (cubeAffine x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.unit_holder_affine_transport
statement:
theorem unit_holder_affine_transport (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
        HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s R u →
        CubeHolderBall d m s (C * R)
          (fun x => u (cubeAffineInv x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.cubeClamp_fixed
statement:
theorem cubeClamp_fixed {d : ℕ} {x : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ cube d) :
    cubeClamp d x = x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.cubeClamp_mem_cube
statement: theorem cubeClamp_mem_cube (d : ℕ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) : cubeClamp d x ∈ cube d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.cubeClamp_nonexpansive
statement:
theorem cubeClamp_nonexpansive (d : ℕ) (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ‖cubeClamp d x - cubeClamp d y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.contDiffOn_closed_union_of_matching_jets
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_closed_union_of_matching_jets (d m : ℕ)
    (s t : Set (Fin d → ℝ))
    (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t)
    (hus : UniqueDiffOn ℝ s) (hut : UniqueDiffOn ℝ t)
    (hu : UniqueDiffOn ℝ (s ∪ t))
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ m f s) (hft : ContDiffOn ℝ m f t)
    (hmatch : ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x ∈ s ∩ t,
      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j f s x =
        iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j f t x) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m f (s ∪ t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.differentiableOn_closed_union_of_matching_fderiv
statement:
theorem differentiableOn_closed_union_of_matching_fderiv (d : ℕ)
    (s t : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hs : IsClosed s) (ht : IsClosed t)
    (f : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hfs : DifferentiableOn ℝ f s) (hft : DifferentiableOn ℝ f t)
    (hmatch : ∀ x ∈ s ∩ t,
      fderivWithin ℝ f s x = fderivWithin ℝ f t x) :
    DifferentiableOn ℝ f (s ∪ t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.interior_coordPartial_bound_extends
statement:
theorem interior_coordPartial_bound_extends {d m : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    (hinterior : ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ f : Fin j → Fin d,
      ∀ x ∈ openCube d, |coordPartial j u f x| ≤ B) :
    DerivBound d m B u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.tensor_coefficient_bound
statement:
theorem tensor_coefficient_bound (d m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ B → (∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ m) →
        (∀ b : Fin d → Fin (m + 1),
          |MvPolynomial.eval (tensorGridPoint b) p| ≤ B) →
        ∀ a : Fin d → Fin (m + 1), |tensorCoeffs (D := m) p a| ≤ C * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.diagonal_derivative_coordinate_expansion
statement:
theorem diagonal_derivative_coordinate_expansion {d m : ℕ}
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (x h : Fin d → ℝ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u x (fun _ => h) =
      ∑ f : Fin m → Fin d,
        (∏ k : Fin m, h (f k)) * coordPartial m u f x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.topHolder_diagonal_derivative
statement:
theorem topHolder_diagonal_derivative {d m : ℕ} {s L : ℝ}
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hu : TopHolder d m s L u) (x y h : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ cube d) (hy : y ∈ cube d) :
    |iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u x (fun _ => h) -
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u y (fun _ => h)| ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s * ‖h‖ ^ m

Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.finite_order_lower_jet_second_symmetric
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.homogeneous_taylor_jet_above_degree
statement:
theorem homogeneous_taylor_jet_above_degree {d j k : ℕ} (hkj : k < j)
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (f : Fin j → Fin d) :
    coordPartial j
      (fun z => (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x (fun _ => z - x)) f x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.homogeneous_taylor_jet_below_degree
statement:
theorem homogeneous_taylor_jet_below_degree {d j k : ℕ} (hjk : j < k)
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) (f : Fin j → Fin d) :

      (fun z => (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x (fun _ => z - x)) f x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.taylor_expression_polynomial
statement:
theorem taylor_expression_polynomial (d m : ℕ)
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ,
      (∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ m) ∧
      ∀ y : Fin d → ℝ,
        MvPolynomial.eval y p =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
            (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
              iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x (fun _ => y - x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.segment_iteratedDeriv_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem segment_iteratedDeriv_eq_diagonal {d m : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    {x y : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ openCube d) (hy : y ∈ cube d)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    iteratedDeriv k (fun r : ℝ => u (x + r • (y - x))) t =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x + t • (y - x)) (fun _ => y - x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.segment_mem_openCube
statement:
theorem segment_mem_openCube {d : ℕ} {x y : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ openCube d) (hy : y ∈ cube d)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    x + t • (y - x) ∈ openCube d

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.segment_line_contDiffOn_before_endpoint
statement:
theorem segment_line_contDiffOn_before_endpoint {d m : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    {x y : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ openCube d) (hy : y ∈ cube d)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t < 1) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun r : ℝ => u (x + r • (y - x))) (Set.Icc 0 t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.segment_line_topHolder_before_endpoint
statement:
theorem segment_line_topHolder_before_endpoint {d m : ℕ} {s L : ℝ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    (hs : 0 < s) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hholder : TopHolder d m s L u)
    {x y : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ openCube d) (hy : y ∈ cube d)
    {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t < 1)
    {r w : ℝ} (hr : r ∈ Set.Icc 0 t) (hw : w ∈ Set.Icc 0 t) :
    |iteratedDeriv m (fun q : ℝ => u (x + q • (y - x))) r -
      iteratedDeriv m (fun q : ℝ => u (x + q • (y - x))) w| ≤
      ((d : ℝ) + 1) ^ m * L * ‖y - x‖ ^ ((m : ℝ) + s) * |r - w| ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.line_holder_taylor
statement:
theorem line_holder_taylor (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (v : ℝ → ℝ) (a b L : ℝ),
        a < b → 0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ m v (Set.Icc a b) →
        (∀ z ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ w ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          |iteratedDeriv m v z - iteratedDeriv m v w| ≤ L * |z - w| ^ s) →
        ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          |v y - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
              (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ * iteratedDeriv k v x * (y - x) ^ k| ≤
            C * L * |y - x| ^ ((m : ℝ) + s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.top_holder_taylor_remainder
statement:
theorem top_holder_taylor_remainder (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
        0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d) → TopHolder d m s L u →
        ∀ x ∈ openCube d, ∀ y ∈ cube d,
          |u y - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
              (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x (fun _ => y - x)| ≤
            C * L * ‖y - x‖ ^ ((m : ℝ) + s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.taylor_polynomial_grid_bound
statement:
theorem taylor_polynomial_grid_bound (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (M L : ℝ),
        0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ L → ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d) →
        (∀ y ∈ cube d, |u y| ≤ M) → TopHolder d m s L u →
        ∀ x ∈ openCube d, ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ,
          (∀ y : Fin d → ℝ,
            MvPolynomial.eval y p =
              ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
                (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ *
                  iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u x (fun _ => y - x)) →
          ∀ b : Fin d → Fin (m + 1),
            |MvPolynomial.eval (tensorGridPoint b) p| ≤ C * (M + L)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.tensor_polynomial_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem tensor_polynomial_deriv_bound (d m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℝ) (B : ℝ),
        0 ≤ B → (∀ i, p.degreeOf i ≤ m) →
        (∀ b : Fin d → Fin (m + 1),
          |MvPolynomial.eval
            (Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Approximation.Chebyshev.tensorGridPoint b) p| ≤ B) →
        ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ f : Fin j → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ cube d,
          |coordPartial j (fun z => MvPolynomial.eval z p) f x| ≤ C * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.contracted_cube_ambient_data
statement:
theorem contracted_cube_ambient_data {d m : ℕ} {s t M L : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t < 1) (hs : 0 < s)
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d))
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ cube d, |u x| ≤ M)
    (hL : TopHolderOn (cube d) m s L u) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => u (t • x)) (cube d) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ cube d, |u (t • x)| ≤ M) ∧
      TopHolder d m s L (fun x => u (t • x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.interior_coordJet_bound_extends
statement:
theorem interior_coordJet_bound_extends {d m j : ℕ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)

    (f : Fin j → Fin d)
    (hinterior : ∀ x ∈ openCube d, |coordJetOn (cube d) j u f x| ≤ B) :
    ∀ x ∈ cube d, |coordJetOn (cube d) j u f x| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_sub_le_of_succ_bound
statement:
theorem norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_sub_le_of_succ_bound
    {d j m : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)}
    (hconv : Convex ℝ S) (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    {v : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ m v S)
    (hj : j < m) {R : ℝ}
    (hbound : ∀ z ∈ S, ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (j + 1) v S z‖ ≤ R)
    {x y : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) :
    ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j v S x -
      iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j v S y‖ ≤ R * ‖x - y‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_coord_multilinear_norm_constant
statement:
theorem exists_coord_multilinear_norm_constant (d m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ j ≤ m,
        ∀ T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Fin d → ℝ) ℝ,
        ∀ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B →
          (∀ f : Fin j → Fin d,
            |T (fun k => Pi.single (f k) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ B) →
          ‖T‖ ≤ C * B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_full_intrinsic_jet_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_full_intrinsic_jet_bounds (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall d m s L u →
        (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x ∈ cube d,
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j u (cube d) x‖ ≤ C * L) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ cube d, ∀ y ∈ cube d,
          ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (cube d) x -
            iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m u (cube d) y‖
            ≤ C * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.tendsto_multilinearMap_of_coordinate_tendsto
statement:
theorem tendsto_multilinearMap_of_coordinate_tendsto
    (d j : ℕ) {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {l : Filter α}
    (F : α → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Fin d → ℝ) ℝ)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Fin d → ℝ) ℝ)

statement:
theorem contDiffOn_rectAffine {d m : ℕ}
    (lo hi lo' hi' : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ i, lo i < hi i)
    (htarget : ∀ i, lo' i < hi' i)
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (rectBox lo' hi')) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => u (rectAffine lo hi lo' hi' x))
      (rectBox lo hi)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.coordJetOn_rectAffine
statement:
theorem coordJetOn_rectAffine {d j : ℕ}
    (lo hi lo' hi' : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ i, lo i < hi i)
    (htarget : ∀ i, lo' i < hi' i)
    (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (f : Fin j → Fin d)
    {x : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ rectBox lo hi) :
    coordJetOn (rectBox lo hi) j
        (fun z => u (rectAffine lo hi lo' hi' z)) f x =
      (∏ k : Fin j, (hi' (f k) - lo' (f k)) /
        (hi (f k) - lo (f k))) *
        coordJetOn (rectBox lo' hi') j u f
          (rectAffine lo hi lo' hi' x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectAffine_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_rectAffine_linearEquiv {d : ℕ}
    (lo hi lo' hi' : Fin d → ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ i, lo i < hi i)
    (htarget : ∀ i, lo' i < hi' i) :
    ∃ e : (Fin d → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin d → ℝ),
      (∀ x i, e x i = (hi' i - lo' i) / (hi i - lo i) * x i) ∧
      (∀ x, rectAffine lo hi lo' hi' x =
        e x + (fun i => lo' i -
          (hi' i - lo' i) / (hi i - lo i) * lo i))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectAffine_holder_constant
statement:
theorem exists_rectAffine_holder_constant {d : ℕ}
    (lo hi lo' hi' : Fin d → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hsource : ∀ i, lo i < hi i)
    (htarget : ∀ i, lo' i < hi' i) :
  ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        HolderBallOn (rectBox lo' hi') m s L u →
        HolderBallOn (rectBox lo hi) m s (C * L)
          (fun x => u (rectAffine lo hi lo' hi' x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.rectAffine_leftCollar_eq_normalize
statement:
theorem rectAffine_leftCollar_eq_normalize {d : ℕ}
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (hbox : ∀ j, lo j < hi j) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    rectAffine (rectLeftLower lo hi m i) hi
      (fun j => if j = i then -1 - (1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1) else -1)

    rectAffine lo hi (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => 1) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.reflection_weighted_coordinate_jet
statement:
theorem reflection_weighted_coordinate_jet (d m : ℕ) (i : Fin d)
    (a : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      (∑ q : Fin (m + 1),
        a q * (-((q.val : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (k.val : ℕ)) = 1)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ m)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin j => Fin d → ℝ) ℝ)
    (f : Fin j → Fin d) :
    (∑ q : Fin (m + 1), a q *
      T (fun k =>
        (if f k = i then -((q.val : ℝ) + 1) else 1) •
          Pi.single (f k) (1 : ℝ))) =
      T (fun k => Pi.single (f k) (1 : ℝ))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.leftFaceSample_coordinate_jet_tendsto_face
statement:

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.coordJetOn_rectBox_neg
statement:
theorem coordJetOn_rectBox_neg {d j : ℕ}

    {x : Fin d → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ rectBox (fun i => -hi i) (fun i => -lo i)) :
    coordJetOn (rectBox (fun i => -hi i) (fun i => -lo i)) j

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectTwoFaceReflection_holder_constant

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_fixedCubeNeighborhood_holder_constant
statement:
theorem exists_fixedCubeNeighborhood_holder_constant
    (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ i, lo i < -1 ∧ 1 < hi i) ∧ 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall d m s L u →
        ∃ v : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ,
          Set.EqOn v u (cube d) ∧
          HolderBallOn (rectBox lo hi) m s (C * L) v

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.ScaledJetBounds.first_holder
statement:
theorem ScaledJetBounds.first_holder {β h C : ℝ} {f : E → ℝ}

    (hh : 0 < h) (x y : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ 2 * C * ‖x - y‖ ^ (β - 1)

Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_contDiff

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_fderiv
statement:
theorem signedSum_fderiv (σ : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → E → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i)) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f) x = ∑ i, σ i • fderiv ℝ (f i) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_jets_eq
statement:
theorem signedSum_jets_eq {K : ι → Set E} {h δ : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i))
    (σ : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ K i) :
    signedSum σ f x = σ i * f i x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f) x = σ i • fderiv ℝ (f i) x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f)) x =
        σ i • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f i)) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_jets_zero
statement:
theorem signedSum_jets_zero {K : ι → Set E} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i))
    (σ : ι → ℝ) (x : E) (hx : ∀ i, x ∉ K i) :
    signedSum σ f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f) x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f)) x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_second_fderiv
statement:
theorem signedSum_second_fderiv (σ : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → E → ℝ)

      ∑ i, σ i • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (f i)) x

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_sub_outside
statement:
theorem signedSum_sub_outside {K : ι → Set E} {h δ : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 2 (f i))
    (σ : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (x y : E) (hx : x ∈ K i) (hy : y ∉ K i) :
    signedSum σ f x - signedSum σ f y =
      σ i * (f i x - f i y) - signedSum σ f y

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.separated_distance_holder

    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)

statement:
theorem signedSum_first_bound {K : ι → Set E} {β h δ C : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_first_holder
statement:
theorem signedSum_first_holder {K : ι → Set E} {β h δ C : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hbound : ∀ i, ScaledJetBounds β h (f i) C)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : 1 < β) (hβ2 : β ≤ 2)
    (σ : ι → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, |σ i| ≤ 1) (x y : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f) x - fderiv ℝ (signedSum σ f) y‖ ≤

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_uniform_holder
statement:
theorem signedSum_uniform_holder {K : ι → Set E} {β h δ C : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h ≤ 1) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hbound : ∀ i, ScaledJetBounds β h (f i) C)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : 0 < β) (hβ2 : β ≤ 2)
    (σ : ι → ℝ) (hσ : ∀ i, |σ i| ≤ 1) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_value_bound
statement:
theorem signedSum_value_bound {K : ι → Set E} {β h δ C : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hbound : ∀ i, ScaledJetBounds β h (f i) C)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.signedSum_value_holder
statement:
theorem signedSum_value_holder {K : ι → Set E} {β h δ C : ℝ} {f : ι → E → ℝ}
    (hsep : SupportSeparation K h δ) (hh : 0 < h) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hloc : JetLocality f K) (hbound : ∀ i, ScaledJetBounds β h (f i) C)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hβ : 0 < β) (hβ1 : β ≤ 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_diagonal
statement:
theorem iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_diagonal
    {d m : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin d → ℝ)}
    (huniq : UniqueDiffOn ℝ S)
    {v w : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ m v S) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ m w S)
    {x : Fin d → ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S) (z : Fin d → ℝ) :
    iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (fun t => v t * w t) S x (fun _ => z) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (m.choose i : ℝ) *
        (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ i v S x (fun _ => z) *
          iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (m - i) w S x (fun _ => z))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.norm_bilinear_sum_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_bilinear_sum_sub_le
    {ι E F G : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (B : E →L[ℝ] F →L[ℝ] G) (hB : ‖B‖ ≤ 1)
    (t : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ c i)
    (a a' : ι → E) (b b' : ι → F) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ t, c i • B (a i) (b i) -
        ∑ i ∈ t, c i • B (a' i) (b' i)‖ ≤
      ∑ i ∈ t, c i *
        (‖a i - a' i‖ * ‖b i‖ + ‖a' i‖ * ‖b i - b' i‖)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.continuousMultilinearMap_eq_of_symmetric_diagonal
statement:
theorem continuousMultilinearMap_eq_of_symmetric_diagonal
    {d m : ℕ}
    (A B : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => Fin d → ℝ) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (v : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ),
      A (v ∘ σ) = A v)
    (hB : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (v : Fin m → Fin d → ℝ),
      B (v ∘ σ) = B v)
    (hdiag : ∀ z : Fin d → ℝ, A (fun _ => z) = B (fun _ => z)) :
    A = B

statement:
-- `EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin d) ℝ` is the existing continuous linear equivalence
-- to the coordinate sup-norm space. Transfer compact support via its homeomorphism.
theorem oddEuclidean_hasCompactSupport {d : ℕ} : HasCompactSupport (oddEuclidean (d := d))

statement:
theorem oddEuclidean_jets_zero {d : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))

    oddEuclidean x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ oddEuclidean x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (oddEuclidean (d := d))) x = 0

-- the coordinate evaluation continuous linear maps, and `ContDiff.mul`.
theorem oddProduct_contDiff {d : ℕ} : ContDiff ℝ 2 (oddProduct (d := d))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.oddProduct_hasCompactSupport
statement:
-- Reuse the cube argument of CubeExtension.productBump_hasCompactSupport:
-- `isCompact_pi_infinite (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)` and
-- `HasCompactSupport.intro`. Off the cube, one cutoff factor is zero.
-- The d = 0 branch is identically zero; do not introduce a positive-dimension premise.

    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ JetBounds (oddProduct (d := d)) C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.oddProduct_jets_zero
statement:
-- Failure of closed coordinate support supplies a STRICT exterior coordinate.
-- Its continuous absolute value stays > 1 on a neighborhood; the product is
-- eventually zero there. Apply the closed `jets_zero_of_eventually_zero` helper.
theorem oddProduct_jets_zero {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ) (hx : x ∉ coordinateSupport d) :
    oddProduct x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ oddProduct x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (oddProduct (d := d))) x = 0

statement:
theorem radialPlateau_bounds (P : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.radialPlateau_contDiff
statement:
-- Use `contDiff_iff_contDiffAt`. If P x = 0, `radialPlateau_eventually_one`
-- identifies the germ with a constant. Otherwise `contDiffAt_norm ℝ` composed
-- with P and `plateau_contDiff.contDiffAt` handles the ordinary chain rule.
-- Primary reference: Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Calculus.lean,
-- pinned commit db584cd6d46c92f209a44c0f1c829460d327499d, contDiffAt_norm.
theorem radialPlateau_contDiff (P : E →L[ℝ] F) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (radialPlateau P)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.radialPlateau_eventually_one
statement:
theorem radialPlateau_eventually_one (P : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) (hx : ‖P x‖ < 1) :
    ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, radialPlateau P y = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.radialPlateau_jets_zero
statement:
theorem radialPlateau_jets_zero (P : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E) (hx : 2 ≤ ‖P x‖) :
    radialPlateau P x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (radialPlateau P) x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (radialPlateau P)) x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.radialPlateau_uniform_jetBounds
statement:
-- `ContinuousLinearMap.iteratedFDeriv_comp_right` and the norm bound for
-- `ContinuousMultilinearMap.compContinuousLinearMap` give the codomain jet
-- bound multiplied by ‖P‖^j. Relate j=1,2 to nested ambient fderiv via
-- `norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv` and the order-one norm identity.
theorem radialPlateau_uniform_jetBounds : ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ (P : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E),
      |radialPlateau P x| ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (radialPlateau P) x‖ ≤ C * ‖P‖ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (radialPlateau P)) x‖ ≤ C * ‖P‖ ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.mixedProfile_contDiff
statement:
-- Compose `oddEuclidean_contDiff` with the first continuous linear projection
-- of `EuclideanSpace.sumEquivProd`, and use `radialPlateau_contDiff` for the
-- second projection. Multiply the two C² functions and unfold only to identify
-- the exact existing formula. This reuses local constancy at projected zero.
-- Primary source: Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/PiL2.lean, sumEquivProd,
-- and `radialPlateau_contDiff` for the norm composition.
theorem mixedProfile_contDiff {t c : ℕ} : ContDiff ℝ 2 (mixedProfile (t := t) (c := c))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.mixedProfile_hasCompactSupport
statement:
-- Split the ambient space using `EuclideanSpace.sumEquivProd`. On the product,
-- use the compact set `tsupport oddEuclidean ×ˢ Metric.closedBall 0 2`,
-- then transfer it through the inverse homeomorphism. Outside this set either
-- the tangent factor is zero or `plateau_eq_zero` kills the radial factor.
-- Neither individual factor pulled back to the ambient space has compact
-- support in general: both coordinate projections can have nontrivial kernels.
theorem mixedProfile_hasCompactSupport {t c : ℕ} :
    HasCompactSupport (mixedProfile (t := t) (c := c))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.mixedProfile_jetBounds
statement:
theorem mixedProfile_jetBounds (t c : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ JetBounds (mixedProfile (t := t) (c := c)) C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.mixedProfile_jets_zero
statement:
-- Negating mixedSupport gives a strict tangent exterior coordinate or a strict
-- complementary radius > 2. Continuity keeps that strict inequality on a
-- neighborhood, where one factor vanishes. Apply `jets_zero_of_eventually_zero`
-- to the whole product, avoiding second-derivative product expansions.
-- Keep the t = 0 and c = 0 cases; no positive-dimension hypothesis is needed.
theorem mixedProfile_jets_zero {t c : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin t ⊕ Fin c))
    (hx : x ∉ mixedSupport t c) :
    mixedProfile x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ mixedProfile x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (mixedProfile (t := t) (c := c))) x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectangular_smooth_cutoff
statement:
theorem exists_rectangular_smooth_cutoff (d m : ℕ)
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (hmargin : ∀ i, lo i < -1 ∧ 1 < hi i) :
    ∃ χ : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ cube d, χ x = 1) ∧
      tsupport χ ⊆ rectOpenBox lo hi ∧
      ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧
        ∀ j ≤ m + 1, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ x‖ ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectBox_boundary_point_le
statement:
theorem exists_rectBox_boundary_point_le {d : ℕ}

    ∃ z : Fin d → ℝ,
      z ∈ rectBox lo hi ∧ z ∉ rectOpenBox lo hi ∧ ‖x - z‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.holder_modulus_on_rectBox_of_openBox
statement:
theorem holder_modulus_on_rectBox_of_openBox
    {d : ℕ} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (hwidth : ∀ i, lo i < hi i)
    (J : (Fin d → ℝ) → F) (hJ : Continuous J)
    (s C : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hopen : ∀ x ∈ rectOpenBox lo hi, ∀ y ∈ rectOpenBox lo hi,
      ‖J x - J y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ s) :
    ∀ x ∈ rectBox lo hi, ∀ y ∈ rectBox lo hi,
      ‖J x - J y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.rectCutoffExtension_contDiff
statement:
theorem rectCutoffExtension_contDiff {d : ℕ} (m : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.rectCutoffExtension_contDiff_eqOn_cube

theorem rectCutoffExtension_contDiff_eqOn_cube (d m : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.rectCutoffExtension_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem rectCutoffExtension_iteratedFDeriv_eq_zero_of_not_mem

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectCutoffExtension_local_jet_constant
statement:
theorem exists_rectCutoffExtension_local_jet_constant (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (lo hi : Fin d → ℝ) (hmargin : ∀ i, lo i < -1 ∧ 1 < hi i)

    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hχbound : ∀ j ≤ m + 1, ∀ x,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j χ x‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (v : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
        HolderBallOn (rectBox lo hi) m s R v →
      ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x ∈ rectOpenBox lo hi,
          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (rectCutoffExtension lo hi χ v) x‖ ≤ C * R

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_rectCutoffExtension_jet_constant
statement:
theorem exists_rectCutoffExtension_jet_constant (d m : ℕ) (s : ℝ)

        ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x,

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.reflection_taylor_polynomial
statement:
theorem reflection_taylor_polynomial (m : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ k : Fin (m + 1),
      (∑ i : Fin (m + 1),
        a i * (-((i.val : ℝ) + 1)) ^ (k.val : ℕ)) = 1)
    (c : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (m + 1),
      a i * (∑ k : Fin (m + 1),
        c k * ((-((i.val : ℝ) + 1)) * t) ^ (k.val : ℕ))) =
      ∑ k : Fin (m + 1), c k * t ^ (k.val : ℕ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.coordJetOn_unitCube_eq_ambient
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_productBump_top_modulus
statement:
theorem exists_productBump_top_modulus {d : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    let m := ⌈β⌉₊ - 1
    let s := β - (m : ℝ)
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x y : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (productBump (d := d)) x -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (productBump (d := d)) y‖ ≤
        C * ‖x - y‖ ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_scaledProductBump_deriv_bound
statement:
theorem exists_scaledProductBump_deriv_bound {d : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    let m := ⌈β⌉₊ - 1
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (x₀ : Fin d → ℝ) (j : ℕ), j ≤ m → ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (scaledProductBump β h x₀) x‖ ≤ C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_scaledProductBump_holderBallOn
statement:
theorem exists_scaledProductBump_holderBallOn {d : ℕ}
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    let m := ⌈β⌉₊ - 1
    let s := β - (m : ℝ)
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (b amp h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x₀ : Fin d → ℝ,
      HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s (|b| + |amp| * A)
        (fun x => b + amp * h ^ β *
          productBump (fun i => (x i - x₀ i) / h))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_scaledProductBump_top_modulus
statement:
theorem exists_scaledProductBump_top_modulus {d : ℕ} (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    let m := ⌈β⌉₊ - 1
    let s := β - (m : ℝ)
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (x₀ x y : Fin d → ℝ),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (scaledProductBump β h x₀) x -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (scaledProductBump β h x₀) y‖ ≤
        C * ‖x - y‖ ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_uniform_scaledProductBump_holderBallOn
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_scaledProductBump_holderBallOn {d : ℕ}
    (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 < β) :
    let m := ⌈β⌉₊ - 1
    let s := β - (m : ℝ)
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x₀ : Fin d → ℝ,
      HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s A (scaledProductBump β h x₀)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.holderBallOn_unitCube_add_const_mul
statement:
theorem holderBallOn_unitCube_add_const_mul {d m : ℕ} {s R : ℝ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ} (_hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hu : HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s R u) (b amp : ℝ) :
    HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s (|b| + |amp| * R)
      (fun x => b + amp * u x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.holderBallOn_unitCube_of_ambient_bounds
statement:
theorem holderBallOn_unitCube_of_ambient_bounds {d m : ℕ} {s R : ℝ}
    {u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ}
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) u)
    (hbound : ∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j u x‖ ≤ R)
    (hmod : ∀ x y : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u y‖ ≤
        R * ‖x - y‖ ^ s) :
    HolderBallOn (unitCube d) m s R u

statement:
theorem productBump_contDiff {d : ℕ} :
    ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (productBump (d := d))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.productBump_eq_zero_of_coordinate
statement:
theorem productBump_eq_zero_of_coordinate {d : ℕ} (x : Fin d → ℝ)
    {i : Fin d} (hi : 1 ≤ |x i|) : productBump x = 0

statement:
theorem productBump_hasCompactSupport {d : ℕ} :
