name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.productBump_iteratedFDeriv_bounded
statement:
theorem productBump_iteratedFDeriv_bounded {d : ℕ} (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : Fin d → ℝ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (productBump (d := d)) x‖ ≤ C

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.productBump_zero
statement: theorem productBump_zero {d : ℕ} : productBump (d := d) 0 = 1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_contDiff
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_contDiff {d : ℕ} (β h : ℝ)
    (x₀ : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (scaledProductBump β h x₀)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_eq_coordinate_div
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_eq_coordinate_div {d : ℕ} (β : ℝ)
    {h : ℝ} (_hh : h ≠ 0) (x₀ x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    scaledProductBump β h x₀ x =
      h ^ β * productBump (fun i => (x i - x₀ i) / h)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledProductBump_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
theorem scaledProductBump_iteratedFDeriv {d : ℕ} (j : ℕ)
    (β h : ℝ) (x₀ x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (scaledProductBump β h x₀) x =
      (h ^ β) • ((h⁻¹) ^ j •
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (productBump (d := d)) (h⁻¹ • (x - x₀)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_contDiff
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_contDiff (β h : ℝ) (z : E) {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) :
    ContDiff ℝ 2 (scaledCopy β h z f)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_fderiv
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_fderiv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h) :
    fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f) x =
      (h ^ β * h⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ f (h⁻¹ • (x - z))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_iteratedFDeriv
statement:
-- Restrict hf to the finite natural order j using hj (casts into WithTop ℕ∞).
-- These Mathlib identities include j=0 and h=0; this theorem deliberately
-- imposes neither a positive bandwidth nor an infinite-order smoothness premise.
theorem scaledCopy_iteratedFDeriv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 2) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (scaledCopy β h z f) x =
      (h ^ β) • ((h⁻¹) ^ j • iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (h⁻¹ • (x - z)))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_jets_zero
statement:
theorem scaledCopy_jets_zero (β h : ℝ) (z : E) {f : E → ℝ} {K : Set E}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x = 0)
    (x : E) (hx : x ∉ scaledSupport h z K) :
    scaledCopy β h z f x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f) x = 0 ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f)) x = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.scaledCopy_second_fderiv
statement:
-- First prove scaledCopy_fderiv as an equality of functions (funext).
-- Differentiate that identity using C¹ regularity of fderiv f from hf.
-- Constant scalar dilation contributes another h⁻¹; no third derivative is needed.
theorem scaledCopy_second_fderiv (β h : ℝ) (z x : E) {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hh : 0 < h) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (scaledCopy β h z f)) x =
      (h ^ β * (h⁻¹) ^ 2) • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) (h⁻¹ • (x - z))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_global_holder_extension_zero
statement:
theorem exists_global_holder_extension_zero (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin 0 → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall 0 m s L u →
        ∃ U : (Fin 0 → ℝ) → ℝ,
          Set.EqOn U u (cube 0) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ m U ∧
          (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j U x‖ ≤ A * L) ∧
          (∀ x y,
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U y‖
              ≤ A * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeExtension.exists_global_holder_extension_order_zero
statement:
theorem exists_global_holder_extension_order_zero (d : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
        CubeHolderBall d 0 s L u →
        ∃ U : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ,
          Set.EqOn U u (cube d) ∧
          ContDiff ℝ 0 U ∧
          (∀ j ≤ 0, ∀ x, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j U x‖ ≤ A * L) ∧
          (∀ x y,
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 U x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 U y‖
              ≤ A * L * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_coordPartial
statement:
theorem affine_coordPartial {d j : ℕ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (f : Fin j → Fin d) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    coordPartial j (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ j * coordPartial j u f (cubeAffine x)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_holderBall
statement:
theorem affine_holderBall {d m : ℕ} {s R : ℝ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hu : HolderBall d m s R u) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) (unitCube d) ∧
    (∀ j ≤ m, ∀ f : Fin j → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial j (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ j * R) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d, ∀ y ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x -
        coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f y| ≤
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m : ℝ) + s) * R) * ‖x - y‖ ^ s)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.affine_topHolder
statement:
theorem affine_topHolder {d m : ℕ} {s L : ℝ} (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ m u (cube d)) (hL : TopHolder d m s L u) :
    ∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ unitCube d, ∀ y ∈ unitCube d,
      |coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f x -
        coordPartial m (fun z => u (cubeAffine z)) f y| ≤
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ((m : ℝ) + s) * L) * ‖x - y‖ ^ s

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.sum_coordCount
statement:
theorem sum_coordCount {d m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → Fin d) :
    (∑ i : Fin d, coordCount f i) = m

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.CubeInterpolation.euclidean_to_topHolder
statement:
theorem euclidean_to_topHolder (d m : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (u : (Fin d → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : ℝ),
        0 ≤ L →
        (∀ f : Fin m → Fin d, ∀ x ∈ cube d, ∀ y ∈ cube d,
          |coordPartial m u f x - coordPartial m u f y| ≤
            L * euclideanDistance x y ^ s) →
        TopHolder d m s (C * L) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.factorJet_abs_le_four
statement:
theorem factorJet_abs_le_four (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I) (p q : ℕ) :
    |factorJet J i p q a u| ≤ 4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_abs_le
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_abs_le (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs ys : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u)
    (hxs : xs.length ≤ 2) (hys : ys.length ≤ 2) :
    |leibnizTerm I J xs ys a u| ≤ 256 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_abs_le
statement:
theorem productJet22_abs_le (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : FactorBoundsAt I J a u) :
    |productJet22 I J a u| ≤
      256 * (I.card : ℝ) ^ 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_abs_le_on_rectangle
statement:
theorem productJet22_abs_le_on_rectangle (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a₀ a₁ u₀ u₁ : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc a₀ a₁, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc u₀ u₁, FactorBoundsAt I J a u) :
    ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc a₀ a₁, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc u₀ u₁,
      |productJet22 I J a u| ≤
        256 * (I.card : ℝ) ^ 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ I.card

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_factorJet_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_factorJet_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => factorJet J i p 0 b u)
      (factorJet J i (p + 1) 0 a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_factorJet_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_factorJet_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ I)
    (p q : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ 2) (hq : q ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => factorJet J i p q a v)
      (factorJet J i p (q + 1) a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : AChainsAt I J a u) (hlen : xs.length ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => leibnizTerm I J xs [] b u)
      (∑ k ∈ I, leibnizTerm I J (k :: xs) [] a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_leibnizTerm_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (xs ys : List ι) (a u : ℝ) (h : UChainsAt I J a u)
    (hxs : xs.length ≤ 2) (hys : ys.length ≤ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => leibnizTerm I J xs ys a v)
      (∑ k ∈ I, leibnizTerm I J xs (k :: ys) a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet10_a
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet10_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => productJet10 I J b u) (productJet20 I J a u) a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet20_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet20_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v => productJet20 I J a v) (productJet21 I J a u) u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_productJet21_u
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_productJet21_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : UChainsAt I J a u) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.hasDerivAt_product_a

theorem hasDerivAt_product_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (a u : ℝ)
    (h : AChainsAt I J a u) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_cons_a
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_cons_a (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (xs ys : List ι)
    (k : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hk : k ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J (k :: xs) ys a u =
      factorJet J k (xs.count k + 1) (ys.count k) a u *
        ∏ i ∈ I.erase k, factorJet J i (xs.count i) (ys.count i) a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm_cons_u
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm_cons_u (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι) (xs ys : List ι)
    (k : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hk : k ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J xs (k :: ys) a u =
      factorJet J k (xs.count k) (ys.count k + 1) a u *
        ∏ i ∈ I.erase k, factorJet J i (xs.count i) (ys.count i) a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_all_same
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_all_same (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (r : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) :
    leibnizTerm I J [r, r] [r, r] a u =
      J.f22 r a u * ∏ i ∈ I.erase r, J.f00 i a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_repeated_u_zero
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_repeated_u_zero (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (p q r : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) (hnot : p ≠ r ∨ q ≠ r) :
    leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, r] a u = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.leibnizTerm22_vanishes_outside
statement:
theorem leibnizTerm22_vanishes_outside (I M : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (p q r s : ι) (a u : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ I) (hs : s ∈ I)
    (hzero : ∀ i ∈ I, i ∉ M →
      J.f01 i a u = 0 ∧ J.f11 i a u = 0 ∧
        J.f21 i a u = 0 ∧ J.f22 i a u = 0)
    (houtside : r ∉ M ∨ s ∉ M) :
    leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, s] a u = 0

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.mem_secondSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_secondSupport_iff (ys : List ι) (i : ι) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet20_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem productJet20_eq_diagonal_add_offDiagonal (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a u : ℝ) :
    productJet20 I J a u =
      (∑ i ∈ I, J.f20 i a u * ∏ k ∈ I.erase i, J.f00 k a u) +
      ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ j ∈ I.erase i,
        J.f10 i a u * J.f10 j a u *
          ∏ k ∈ (I.erase i).erase j, J.f00 k a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.productJet22_support_decomposition
statement:
theorem productJet22_support_decomposition (I : Finset ι) (J : FactorJets ι)
    (a u : ℝ) :
    productJet22 I J a u =
      (∑ r ∈ I, J.f22 r a u * ∏ i ∈ I.erase r, J.f00 i a u) +
      ∑ p ∈ I, ∑ q ∈ I, ∑ r ∈ I, ∑ s ∈ I.erase r,
        leibnizTerm I J [p, q] [r, s] a u

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FiniteProduct.secondSupport_pair

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holderDerivOrder_lt
statement: lemma holderDerivOrder_lt {β : ℝ} (hβ : 0 < β) : (holderDerivOrder β : ℝ) < β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holder_taylor_remainder
statement:
theorem holder_taylor_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M β lo hi t a : ℝ}
    (hβ : 0 < β) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc lo hi) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc lo hi)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ((holderDerivOrder β)) f)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc lo hi,
            |iteratedDeriv (holderDerivOrder β) f x - iteratedDeriv (holderDerivOrder β) f y|
              ≤ M * |x - y| ^ (β - ((holderDerivOrder β) : ℝ))) :
    |f a - taylorPoly (holderDerivOrder β) f t a|
      ≤ M / ((holderDerivOrder β)).factorial * |a - t| ^ β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.holder_taylor_remainder_of_lt
statement:
lemma holder_taylor_remainder_of_lt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M β lo hi t a : ℝ} {p : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc lo hi) (ha : a ∈ Set.Icc lo hi)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ p f)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc lo hi, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc lo hi,
            |iteratedDeriv p f x - iteratedDeriv p f y|
              ≤ M * |x - y| ^ (β - (p : ℝ)))
    (hp_pos : 0 < p) (hp_le_beta : (p : ℝ) ≤ β) (hlt : t < a) :
    |f a - taylorPoly p f t a| ≤ M / (p.factorial : ℝ) * |a - t| ^ β

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_eval_base
statement: theorem taylorPoly_eval_base (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : taylorPoly p f t t = f t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_reflect
statement:
lemma taylorPoly_reflect (p : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t a : ℝ) :
    taylorPoly p (fun x => f (2 * t - x)) t (2 * t - a) = taylorPoly p f t a

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorPoly_succ
statement:
lemma taylorPoly_succ (n : ℕ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (t a : ℝ) :
    taylorPoly (n + 1) f t a =
      taylorPoly n f t a
        + iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f t / ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * (a - t) ^ (n + 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.HolderTaylor.taylorWithinEval_eq_taylorPoly
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_contDiffOn
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ k
      (fun z : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0))
      (cube 1)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_coordJetOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_coordJetOn
    (j : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (q : Fin j → Fin 1) (z : Fin 1 → ℝ) (hz : z ∈ cube 1) :
    coordJetOn (cube 1) j
      (fun w : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * w 0)) q z =
      (d / 2) ^ j *
        iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d))
          (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.affine_cube_topHolderOn
statement:
theorem affine_cube_topHolderOn
    (k : ℕ) (α a d L : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (hholder : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
        iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
          L * |x - y| ^ α) :
    TopHolderOn (cube 1) k α
      (L * (d / 2) ^ k * (d / 2) ^ α)
      (fun z : Fin 1 → ℝ => f (a + d / 2 + (d / 2) * z 0))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.within_jet_bound_of_interior_ambient_bound
statement:
theorem within_jet_bound_of_interior_ambient_bound
    (k : ℕ) (a b B : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a b))
    (hinterior : ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b,
      |iteratedDeriv j f x| ≤ B) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b,
      |iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a b) x| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.endpoint_holder_taylor
statement:
theorem endpoint_holder_taylor
    (k : ℕ) (α d L : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
            iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
              L * |x - y| ^ α) →
        ∃ coeff : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ,
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
            |f t - ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), coeff j * (a + d - t) ^ j.val| ≤
              C * (a + d - t) ^ ((k : ℝ) + α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.endpoint_holder_taylor_Icc
statement:
theorem endpoint_holder_taylor_Icc
    (k : ℕ) (α a b L : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hab : a < b) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k f (Set.Icc a b) →
        (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a b,
          |iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) x -
            iteratedDerivWithin k f (Set.Icc a b) y| ≤
              L * |x - y| ^ α) →
        ∃ coeff : Fin (k + 1) → ℝ,
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
            |f t - ∑ j : Fin (k + 1), coeff j * (b - t) ^ j.val| ≤
              C * (b - t) ^ ((k : ℝ) + α)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.lower_jet_holder_of_next_bound
statement:
theorem lower_jet_holder_of_next_bound
    (j : ℕ) (α a d B : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ (j + 1) f (Set.Icc a (a + d)))
    (hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1) f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ B) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      |iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) x -
        iteratedDerivWithin j f (Set.Icc a (a + d)) y| ≤
          (B * d ^ (1 - α)) * |x - y| ^ α

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_contDiffOn
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ (k + 1) (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x in a..t, h x)
      (Set.Icc a (a + d))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_derivWithin
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_derivWithin
    (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ 0 h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      derivWithin (fun u : ℝ => ∫ x in a..u, h x)
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t = h t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.interval_primitive_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
statement:
theorem interval_primitive_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1) (fun u : ℝ => ∫ x in a..u, h x)
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      iteratedDerivWithin j h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_derivWithin
statement:
theorem survival_derivWithin
    (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ 0 h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      derivWithin (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      -h t * Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..t, h x))

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
statement:
theorem survival_iteratedDerivWithin_succ
    (k : ℕ) (a d : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (h : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d))) :
    ∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
      iteratedDerivWithin (j + 1)
        (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
        (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t =
      -(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) *
            iteratedDerivWithin i h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t *
            iteratedDerivWithin (j - i)
              (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
              (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.HolderTaylor.survival_jet_bound_of_integrand_jet_bound
statement:
theorem survival_jet_bound_of_integrand_jet_bound
    (k : ℕ) (d C E : ℝ) (hd : 0 < d) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hE : 0 ≤ E) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiffOn ℝ k h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) →
        (∀ j ≤ k, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin j h (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ C) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..t, h x))| ≤ E) →
        ∀ j ≤ k + 1, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + d),
          |iteratedDerivWithin j
            (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-(∫ x in a..u, h x)))
            (Set.Icc a (a + d)) t| ≤ B

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.fourth_rectangular_remainder_bound
statement:
lemma fourth_rectangular_remainder_bound
    (F Fa Faa FaaU FaaUU : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a u B : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hFa : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt (fun t => F t u) (Fa b u) b)
    (hFaa : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt (fun t => Fa t u) (Faa b u) b)
    (hFaaU : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u,
      HasDerivAt (Faa b) (FaaU b v) v)
    (hFaaUU : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u,
      HasDerivAt (FaaU b) (FaaUU b v) v)
    (hbound : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, ∀ v ∈ Icc 0 u, |FaaUU b v| ≤ B)
    (hF0 : F 0 u = 0) (hFa0 : Fa 0 u = 0)
    (hFaa0 : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, Faa b 0 = 0)
    (hFaaU0 : ∀ b ∈ Icc 0 a, FaaU b 0 = 0) :
    |F a u| ≤ B*a^2*u^2/4

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.quadratic_remainder_bound
statement:
lemma quadratic_remainder_bound (f f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (a B : ℝ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt f (f₁ x) x)
    (hf₁ : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, HasDerivAt f₁ (f₂ x) x)
    (hf₂ : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 a, |f₂ x| ≤ B) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (h10 : f₁ 0 = 0) :
    |f a| ≤ B*a^2/2

statement:
theorem abs_anchorEval_applyFunction_sub_le {n : ℕ} {A B : RectMatrix n n}
    (DA : RealDiagonalization A) (DB : RealDiagonalization B)
    (a b c d : Euc n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : LipschitzWith 1 f) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    {κA κB R : ℝ} (hκA : DA.conditionNumber ≤ κA)
    (hκB : DB.conditionNumber ≤ κB) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R)
    (hRA : DA.SpectrumBound R)
    (hRB : DB.SpectrumBound R) :

      ‖a - b‖ * (κA * R) * ‖c‖ +
      ‖b‖ * ((n : ℝ) ^ 2 * κA * κB * ‖A - B‖) * ‖c‖ +
      ‖b‖ * (κB * R) * ‖c - d‖

theorem applyFunction_sub_eq_dividedDifference {n : ℕ} {A B : RectMatrix n n}

statement:
theorem centered_le_of_differential_inequality
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hψ0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ 0)
    (hψ : ∀ x, 0 < x → a * x < 1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x)
    (hzero : ψ 0 = 0)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hdiff : ∀ x, 0 < x → a * x < 1 →
      x * (1 - a * x) * deriv ψ x - ψ x ≤ b * x ^ 2)
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam) (hlam : a * lam < 1) :
    ψ lam - lam * deriv ψ 0 ≤
      (a * deriv ψ 0 + b) * lam ^ 2 / (1 - a * lam)

theorem inverse_plancherel (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hcont : Continuous G)
    (hG : Integrable G) (hinv : Integrable (𝓕⁻ G)) :
    Integrable (fun ξ => ‖G ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    Integrable (fun v => ‖𝓕⁻ G v‖ ^ 2) ∧ energy (𝓕⁻ G) = energy G

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.abs_rpow_le_scaled_quadratic
statement:
theorem abs_rpow_le_scaled_quadratic (κ h v : ℝ)
    (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) :
    |v| ^ κ ≤ h ^ κ + h ^ (κ - 2) * v ^ 2

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.integrable_weightedEnergy
statement:
theorem integrable_weightedEnergy (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.weightedEnergy_le_interpolation
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_le_interpolation (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    weightedEnergy κ g ≤
      (energy g) ^ (1 - κ / 2) * (weightedEnergy 2 g) ^ (κ / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.weightedEnergy_le_scaled
statement:
theorem weightedEnergy_le_scaled (g : ℝ → ℂ) (κ h : ℝ)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h)
    (h0 : Integrable (fun v => ‖g v‖ ^ 2))
    (h2 : Integrable (fun v => v ^ 2 * ‖g v‖ ^ 2)) :
    weightedEnergy κ g ≤ h ^ κ * energy g + h ^ (κ - 2) * weightedEnergy 2 g

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverse_weightedEnergy_le
statement:
theorem inverse_weightedEnergy_le (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hG : CompactInverseData G)
    (κ : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖𝓕⁻ G v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ G) ≤
      (energy G) ^ (1 - κ / 2) *
        ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 * energy (deriv G)) ^ (κ / 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverse_weightedEnergy_le_scaled
statement:
theorem inverse_weightedEnergy_le_scaled (G : ℝ → ℂ) (hG : CompactInverseData G)
    (κ h : ℝ) (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) :
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ G) ≤
      h ^ κ * energy G + h ^ (κ - 2) * (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 * energy (deriv G)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_deriv_energy_le
statement:
theorem inverseGaussian_deriv_energy_le (F : ℝ → ℂ) (σ h a b : ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F) (hh : 0 < h) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) (hderiv : ∀ ξ, ‖deriv F ξ‖ ≤ b * h ^ 2) :
    energy (deriv (inverseGaussian σ F)) ≤
      (6 / Real.pi) * (b + 12 * Real.pi * a) ^ 2 * h ^ 3 *
        (1 + σ / h) ^ 4 * Real.exp (36 * (σ / h) ^ 2)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_energy_le
statement:

    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) :

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.Fourier.inverseGaussian_weightedEnergy_le
statement:
theorem inverseGaussian_weightedEnergy_le (F : ℝ → ℂ) (κ σ h a b : ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ 1 F) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport F)
    (hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ) (hκ2 : κ ≤ 2) (hh : 0 < h) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hsupport : Function.support F ⊆ Icc (-(3 / (Real.pi * h))) (3 / (Real.pi * h)))
    (hbound : ∀ ξ, ‖F ξ‖ ≤ a * h) (hderiv : ∀ ξ, ‖deriv F ξ‖ ≤ b * h ^ 2)
    (hinv : Integrable (𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F)))
    (hinvD : Integrable (𝓕⁻ (deriv (inverseGaussian σ F)))) :
    Integrable (fun v => |v| ^ κ * ‖𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F) v‖ ^ 2) ∧
    weightedEnergy κ (𝓕⁻ (inverseGaussian σ F)) ≤
      ((6 / Real.pi) * (a ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ 2 *
        (b + 12 * Real.pi * a) ^ 2)) *
      h ^ (κ + 1) * (1 + σ / h) ^ 4 * Real.exp (36 * (σ / h) ^ 2)

    originalObjective X Y β h =

name: Causalean.Mathlib.FWL.residualizedObjective_eq_fwlCoef_add_error
statement:
theorem residualizedObjective_eq_fwlCoef_add_error
    (Y : V) (hQ : IsUnit (gramResid H X).det) (β : Fin K → ℝ) :
    residualizedObjective H X Y β =
      residualizedObjective H X Y (fwlCoef H X Y) +
        inner ℝ

Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.Transcendental.complexExp_width
statement:
theorem complexExp_width (I : ComplexRatInterval) (fuel : ℕ) :
    ComplexRatInterval.width (complexExp I fuel) ≤
      2 * (max (expInterval I.re fuel).maxAbs 0 *
          max (cosInterval I.im fuel).width (sinInterval I.im fuel).width +
        max (cosInterval I.im fuel).maxAbs (sinInterval I.im fuel).maxAbs *
          max (expInterval I.re fuel).width 0)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleAngle_sound
statement:
theorem circleAngle_sound (schedule : Schedule) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ schedule.mesh) :
    (circleAngle schedule k).Contains
      (((2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * ((k : ℝ) / schedule.mesh)) * Complex.I)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleNode_endpoint
statement:
theorem circleNode_endpoint (radius : ℚ) (schedule : Schedule) :
    (circleNode radius schedule schedule.mesh).Contains (radius : ℂ) ∧
      exactCircleNode radius schedule schedule.mesh = (radius : ℂ)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleNode_schedule_correspondence
statement:
theorem circleNode_schedule_correspondence (radius : ℚ) (schedule : Schedule)
    (k operation : ℕ) :
    (circleNodeManifestEntry schedule k operation).schedule.operationCount =
        schedule.operationCount ∧
      (circleNodeManifestEntry schedule k operation).schedule.inputPrecision =
        schedule.inputPrecision ∧
      (circleNodeManifestEntry schedule k operation).schedule.fuel = schedule.fuel ∧
      (circleNodeManifestEntry schedule k operation).schedule.mesh = schedule.mesh ∧
      circleNode radius (circleNodeManifestEntry schedule k operation).schedule k =
        circleNode radius schedule k

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleNode_sound
Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleNode_width
statement:
theorem circleNode_width (radius : ℚ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius)
    (schedule : Schedule) (k : ℕ) :
    ComplexRatInterval.width (circleNode radius schedule k) ≤
      radius * ComplexRatInterval.width (Transcendental.complexExp
        (circleAngle schedule k) schedule.fuel)

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.circleNode_width_at_selected_precision
statement:
theorem circleNode_width_at_selected_precision (radius : ℚ) (hradius : 0 ≤ radius)
    (schedule : Schedule) (target : PosRat)
    (hprecision : schedule.inputPrecision = circleInputPrecision radius target)
    (hfuel : circleExpFuel radius schedule.mesh target ≤ schedule.fuel)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ schedule.mesh) :
    ComplexRatInterval.width (circleNode radius schedule k) ≤ target.1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.CertifiedComplexMap.algorithmError_le_of_modulus
statement:
theorem algorithmError_le_of_modulus {f : CertifiedComplexMap} {ε : PosRat} {fuel : ℕ}
    (h : f.errorModulus ε ≤ fuel) : f.algorithmError fuel ≤ ε.1

name: Causalean.Mathlib.Analysis.IntervalArithmetic.Contour.ContourProgram.nodeManifest_spec
statement:
theorem ContourProgram.nodeManifest_spec (program : ContourProgram)
    {bounds : ContourValueBounds program} {separation : PosRat}
    (scheduled : CertifiedProgramSchedule program bounds separation) (k : ℕ) :
    (program.nodeManifest scheduled k).length = program.operationCount ∧
      ∀ event ∈ program.nodeManifest scheduled k,
        event.schedule = scheduled.schedule ∧
          event.schedule.operationCount = program.operationCount
